starting-out-talking-to-edmond.speaker: Edmond
starting-out-talking-to-edmond.text: Not good at all my friend. It's Elena, she's been taken...

starting-out-talking-to-edmond.speaker: Edmond
starting-out-talking-to-edmond.text: The Knights of Ardougne. They claimed she was inciting rebellion against the king. Apparently she's been going around telling people that the plague isn't real...

starting-out-talking-to-edmond.player: Oh dear... This is a problem.

starting-out-talking-to-edmond.speaker: Edmond
starting-out-talking-to-edmond.text: Is there anything you can do to help us? It feels wrong to ask given what you've done for us before, but we're desperate.

starting-out-talking-to-edmond.prompt: Start the Song of the Elves quest?

steps.player: I'm sure this is all just a misunderstanding. Let me try talking to the king.

steps.speaker: Edmond
steps.text: Thank you friend.

steps.player: I can't help I'm afraid.

starting-out-talking-to-alrena.speaker: Alrena
starting-out-talking-to-alrena.text: Edmond tells me you're helping Elena again. Thank you so much.

talking-to-the-king.speaker: King Lathas
talking-to-the-king.text: Hello [player name]. What can I do for you?

talking-to-the-king.player: I'm here to talk about Elena, apparently she's been imprisoned.

talking-to-the-king.speaker: King Lathas
talking-to-the-king.text: That she has. She was making some heinous accusations.

talking-to-the-king.player: Right... But you and I both know that she's right, the plague is fake.

talking-to-the-king.speaker: King Lathas
talking-to-the-king.text: That's not the point. As I've explained to you before, the plague is a necessary evil. We can't have her exposing the truth and risking everything.

talking-to-the-king.player: But King Tyras is dead, what exactly are we risking?

talking-to-the-king.speaker: King Lathas
talking-to-the-king.text: My brother may be dead but the Dark Lord is still a threat. Until that threat is gone, the plague must remain.

talking-to-the-king.speaker: King Lathas
talking-to-the-king.text: No. I can't take any risks. Now I'm afraid I have business to attend to. You should be on your way.

talking-to-the-king.player: I see. I guess I should let her father know.

talking-to-the-king-talking-to-him-again.speaker: King Lathas
talking-to-the-king-talking-to-him-again.text: Hello [player name]. What can I do for you.

talking-to-the-king-talking-to-him-again.speaker: King Lathas
talking-to-the-king-talking-to-him-again.text: We've been through this already. I will not have the girl freed. She is a threat to Ardougne and will remain imprisoned.

talking-to-the-king-talking-to-him-again.player: I see. I guess I should let her father know.

talking-to-the-king-talking-to-the-knigh.speaker: Knight of Ardougne
talking-to-the-king-talking-to-the-knigh.text: Sorry citizen. Only Knights of Ardougne are allowed in the prison.

talking-to-the-king-talking-to-the-knigh.speaker: Knight of Ardougne
talking-to-the-king-talking-to-the-knigh.text: Hello there citizen. What can I do for you?

talking-to-the-king-talking-to-the-knigh.speaker: Knight of Ardougne
talking-to-the-king-talking-to-the-knigh.text: These stairs lead to the Ardougne Prison. It's home to thieves, murderers and everything in between.

talking-to-the-king-talking-to-the-knigh.player: Sounds lovely. Can I go in?

talking-to-the-king-talking-to-the-knigh.speaker: Knight of Ardougne
talking-to-the-king-talking-to-the-knigh.text: I'm afraid not citizen. Only the Knights of Ardougne are allowed into the prison and I can see that you are no knight.

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.speaker: Edmond
making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.text: Hello there. Have you spoken to the king yet?

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.player: I have.

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.speaker: Edmond
making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.text: And?

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.player: He won't be freeing her I'm afraid.

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.speaker: Edmond
making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.text: But why? I know all this plague business has got her a bit emotional, but can't he see that she's just upset?

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.player: He said she was a threat to Ardougne.

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.speaker: Edmond
making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.text: A threat? But she's no danger to anyone. Why does he think that way?

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.player: Well the thing is...

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.speaker: Edmond
making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.text: What?

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.player: Well... She's right. The plague is a lie. That's why the king had her imprisoned. He was afraid she'd expose the truth.

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.speaker: Edmond
making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.text: The plague is a lie? What do you mean the plague is a lie?

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.player: I guess I have some explaining to do.

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.speaker: Edmond
making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.text: You most certainly do.

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.player: Well, it all started after I freed Elena from West Ardougne. As you can imagine, she was still keen on helping the plague victims and asked me to help her find a cure.
We sent some samples to her old teacher, Guidor in Varrock. He ran some tests and found out that the plague isn't actually real. I confronted the king on this and he admitted it.

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.speaker: Edmond
making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.text: But why?

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.player: The king told me that his brother, King Tyras, was corrupted by the Dark Lord while exploring the lands to the west.
As Tyras was the king of West Ardougne, King Lathas decided to cordon the city off to keep the rest of the world safe.
The plague was the excuse he gave for the quarantine.

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.speaker: Edmond
making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.text: But that doesn't make any sense. Why not just tell the truth? Why lie to everyone and make up a plague? Something doesn't seem right about it all.

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.player: Well you're right about that. Turns out King Lathas was lying about that as well. But I'll get to that in a minute.
After confronting the king, he recruited me and tasked me with helping him stop Tyras. He had me travel through the Underground Pass into the elven forests of Tirannwn.

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.speaker: Edmond
making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.text: Elves? I wasn't even sure they existed anymore.

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.player: Well Tirannwn is full of them. In fact, they're currently in the middle of a civil war.

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.speaker: Edmond
making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.text: An elven civil war? I'm going to need a drink after all of this. So what happened next?

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.player: I met with an ally of King Lathas, an elf called Lord Iorwerth. He's the leader of one of the elven factions. With his help, I was successful in assassinating King Tyras.
With the job done, I returned to Ardougne. However, on my way back, I was intercepted by an elf named Arianwyn, the leader of the rebel elves opposing Lord Iorwerth.
He revealed the truth to me, that King Lathas and Lord Iorwerth are in fact the evil ones. Together they intend to summon this Dark Lord.

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.speaker: Edmond
making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.text: Just when I thought this story couldn't get any worse. The king is evil? Why?

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.player: From what I can tell, King Lathas hated how his father split the kingdom, giving half to him and half to his brother. He wanted his brother dead from the start.
Not only that, he also wants to reclaim Camelot from King Arthur. I think he's hoping that this Dark Lord will help him.

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.speaker: Edmond
making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.text: All of this, just because Lathas wants more land? What about this Lord Iorwerth, what's in it for him?

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.player: I think he wants to use the Dark Lord to defeat the rebel elves and end the civil war. Apparently, it's been going on for hundreds of years.

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.speaker: Edmond
making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.text: I see, this still doesn't explain why the plague was made up though.

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.player: Well since I learnt the truth, I've been helping the rebel elves fight back against King Lathas and Lord Iorwerth.
I recently discovered that Lord Iorwerth believes the secrets to summoning the Dark Lord lie within the Temple of Light beneath Ardougne.
The plague was made up to hide their mining operation beneath the city.
All the mourners are actually Iorwerth elves in disguise and the people who they claim have died of the plague are actually getting sent into the mines.

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.speaker: Edmond
making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.text: Goodness me Elena, what have you gotten yourself into?

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.speaker: Edmond
making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.text: Thank you for telling me the truth [player name]. I just wish you had told me sooner.

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.speaker: Edmond
making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.text: If even half of what you say about King Lathas is true, then my daughter is in great danger. We need to help her.

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.player: Do you have something in mind?

making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.speaker: Edmond
making-a-knightly-disguise-talking-to-ed.text: I do. They're holding Elena in the city prison beneath the castle. You'll need to disguise yourself as a Knight of Ardougne, infiltrate the prison and find a way to free her.

steps.player: Why me?

steps.speaker: Edmond
steps.text: As much as I hate to admit it, I'm far too old to pass as a knight. It will have to be you.

steps.player: How do I get this disguise?

steps.text: You'll need to get a steel platebody, some steel platelegs and a steel full helm. The plume on the helm will need dying red and you'll need a tabard for the platebody.

steps.speaker: Edmond
steps.text: My wife should be able to help you with the tabard. You'll have to check with her to see what she needs for it. Come back to me once you have everything and we'll discuss what to do next.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.player: The Ardougne Resistance?

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Elena
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: Yes! It all started when you told me the truth about the king. I realised that it would take more than just us two to overthrow him, so I started to find allies for us.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.player: I see, when were you planning on telling me?

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Elena
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: Well I knew you were busy infiltrating the mourners so I didn't want to trouble you until we were all set up. We're just about there now though.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.player: So is this how you ended up in that prison?

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Elena
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: It is. It happened while I was trying to gather more support for us. I was trying to convince some people of the truth behind the plague, but they didn't believe me. They reported me and I was arrested not long after.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.player: Well you've clearly been quite busy. I've also made some progress since we last spoke.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Elena
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: With the mourners? What did you find out?

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.player: The mourners have been searching for a temple under West Ardougne. There's an altar there that they want to use to summon the Dark Lord.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Elena
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: That doesn't sound good at all.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.player: Don't worry, I restored the safeguards on the temple so they shouldn't be able to get in.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Elena
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: Ah, that's good to hear. Do you think we're safe now?

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.player: For now, but we can't rule out King Lathas and Lord Iorwerth finding another way.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Elena
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: Well we can't do anything about Lord Iorwerth, your elf friends will have to sort him out. But if we get our way, Lathas might not be king for much longer.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.player: So what's your plan?

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Elena
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: You've met Councillor Halgrive before, right? He's been helping us put a plan together.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: Good to see you [player name]. Allow me to run you through what we have so far.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: So unluckily for us, the king has total control over the Paladins and the Knights of Ardougne. With them, he has a large army at his disposal, one we cannot hope to stand against.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.player: But you're a councillor, can't you do anything about that?

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: The council serves the king I'm afraid, we can't overrule his decisions. Nor can we take power from him. What we can do however, is step in if the king becomes unfit for rule.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.player: But the king is a traitor, surely that's enough reason.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: It is, but right now it's our word against his. And as you've already seen with Elena, he is keen to keep us silent.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Elena
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: Before I was arrested, we'd hoped to gather enough support among the people to be able to peacefully remove the king from power. Sadly, we've not been able to convince many of them.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: It's no surprise, really. The king has created a clever lie with the plague, one that's easy for people to believe.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Elena
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: Councillor Halgrive has come up with an alternative way to gather support. I can't pretend I totally approve of it, but it seems to be our only option.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: We need people to see the king for what he really is. They're clearly not going to believe us when it comes to the plague, so we'll have to resort to some dirtier tactics.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: When Elena told me about how you freed her from the prison, it gave me an idea...

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: With your disguise, you can appear to be working directly for the king. Any actions you perform in that disguise will seem like they were ordered by him.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.player: I see where this is going. If I upset people while dressed as a Knight of Ardougne, they'll blame the king.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: And once they are upset, they'll be far more likely to believe what we have to say.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Elena
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: You can probably see why I'm not a fan now. If we're to remove the king, it should mark a new start for Ardougne. But if that's all built on a lie, are we any better than the king himself?

options.text: I agree, this is a dangerous path to follow.

steps.player: I agree, this is a dangerous path to follow.

steps.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
steps.text: It is, and yet it seems to be the only path open to us. I fear the danger of inaction could harm the people far more than a few small lies.

options.text: It's not good, but it might be our only option.

steps.player: It's not good, but it might be our only option.

steps.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
steps.text: I agree. I fear the danger of inaction could harm the people far more than a few small lies.

options.text: Who cares, it's for the good of the people.

steps.player: Who cares, it's for the good of the people.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: But who are we to decide that?

steps.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
steps.text: There is no perfect answer here. However, I fear the danger of inaction could harm the people far more than a few small lies.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Elena
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: You're right, it just makes me feel uncomfortable, all of this.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: So, [player name], are you willing to help us?

steps.player: I am.

steps.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
steps.text: Excellent, let's get to work then. Wear your Knight of Ardougne disguise and use it to turn people against the king in East Ardougne.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: You'll want to build support in West Ardougne as well but the knights aren't allowed here. You can use your mourner disguise instead though.

steps.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
steps.text: As you turn people against the king, we'll be on hand to convince them of our cause. If we aim to recruit 80 people from across both parts of Ardougne, we should have quite the army.

steps.player: What sort of things should I do?

steps.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
steps.text: Anything that upsets people really. I suspect some of the others here will have a few suggestions for you. Just keep an eye out for suitable opportunities.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: I'll keep track of how many people we've recruited, just let me know if you need an update.

steps.player: Right, I'd better get started then.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Good luck.

options.text: I need to think about this.

steps.player: I need to think about this.

steps.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
steps.text: Of course, it is a big ask. We'll be here once you have decided.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Carla/Jethick/Kilron/Omart
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: You'd better speak to Elena, she'll fill you in on what's happening here.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.player: What do I need to do again?

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: We need to recruit people into our resistance so that we can overthrow the king. Elena can tell you how many people we've recruited.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: Your role in this is to increase hatred for the king amongst the people. That will allow us to recruit them to our cause.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.player: What sort of things should I do?

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: Disguise yourself appropriately and perform any actions that cause upset with the citizens. With your disguise, people will think you are acting on the orders of the king.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: For East Ardougne, you'll need a Knight of Ardougne disguise. For West Ardougne, you'll want a mourner disguise.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: If you need any suggestions on what to do, ask the others here and see if they have anything for you.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.player: Okay, thanks for the help.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Elena
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: Hey. We haven't recruited anyone into the resistance yet. You should speak to the others if you need help getting started.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Elena
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: Hey. We've recruited [number] people into the resistance so far. We still need [number] more.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.player: Hey there. Do you have any suggestions for this uprising of ours?

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Carla
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: I bet people would get pretty angry if they had their food taken away. You could burn the food stores in West Ardougne and claim it's to protect people from the plague.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.player: Won't people be willing to accept that though if they think it's preventing the plague spreading?

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Carla
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: Some will, but don't forget that it was the authorities that supplied the food in the first place. People will soon get angry if they think that not enough care is being taken with the food.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.player: Ahh I see, that does make sense. I wonder if I can do something similar in East Ardougne as well.
Hey Jethick, got any ideas on how to increase hatred for the king?

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Jethick
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: An increase in taxes would definitely cause some anger, especially if it seems that the king is making personal gain. No one likes the idea of the rich getting richer.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.player: Good thinking, what's the best way to spread that sort of news?

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Jethick
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: You could target the citizens themselves but that would be slow going. I'd recommend going for shopkeepers instead, that will impact more people in less time.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.player: Great, thanks for the help.
Hey, do you two know of any ways I can cause anger at the king?

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Omart
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: We did have an idea. With the plague, lots of people are worried for their health. We could take advantage of that.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Kilron
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: There's not many doctors and nurses around here. You've got Nurse Sarah in West Ardougne and Doctor Orbon in East Ardougne but that's about it.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.speaker: Omart
meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.text: Imagine if the king made a new law stating that all doctors and nurses in Ardougne had to retrain. They'd be out of action for months.

meet-the-ardougne-resistance-planning-a-.player: People wouldn't like that at all, thanks both.

causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-ta.player: I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.

causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-ta.speaker: Priest
causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-ta.text: Taxes? Look at this place, do you think I can afford to pay any taxes?

causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-ta.player: Fighting the plague isn't cheap, the money needs to come from somewhere.

causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-ta.text: If the player is wearing a mourner's outfit:

steps.speaker: Priest
steps.text: As if life in this city couldn't get any worse. Where am I going to find the money?

steps.player: That's for you to work out. The first payment is to be collected soon.

causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-ta.text: If the player is wearing Knight of Ardougne armour:

steps.speaker: Priest
steps.text: A knight wouldn't be telling me this, they're not allowed in West Ardougne. I don't know who you really are, but you should leave.

steps.player: I should probably wear my mourner disguise before doing that.

causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-ta.text: If the player is not wearing either:

steps.speaker: Priest
steps.text: Citizens don't decide new taxes. You should leave.

steps.player: I should probably wear my mourner disguise before doing that.

causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-se.text: If the player is wearing a mourner's outfit:

steps.text: You set fire to the food store.

steps.speaker: Priest
steps.text: What are you doing? The people need that food!

steps.player: Sorry, but we have reason to believe the food is contaminated. This is for the good of everyone.

steps.speaker: Priest
steps.text: But people will starve!

steps.player: I'm just doing my job. You should take it up with the king if you don't like it.

causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-se.text: If the player is not wearing a mourner's outfit:

steps.player: I should probably wear my mourner disguise before doing that.

causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-re.player: I have some orders from the king for you.

causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-re.text: If the player is wearing a mourner's outfit:

steps.speaker: Nurse Sarah
steps.text: Orders?

steps.player: Yes. The king is concerned about the plague spreading into East Ardougne. He has ordered that all doctors and nurses retrain to ensure they are capable of dealing with the plague.

steps.speaker: Nurse Sarah
steps.text: But I don't have time to retrain! The people here need me! Who will help them if I'm gone?

steps.player: I'm sure the king considered all of that before making his decision.

steps.speaker: Nurse Sarah
steps.text: Well he may be king but he clearly doesn't have a clue about health. This could be disasterous for the city!

causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-re.text: If the player is wearing Knight of Ardougne armour:

steps.speaker: Nurse Sarah
steps.text: You knights aren't allowed in West Ardougne. You should leave.

steps.player: I should probably wear my mourner disguise before doing that.

causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-re.text: If the player is not wearing either:

steps.speaker: Nurse Sarah
steps.text: I don't take orders from citizens. Now I have work to be doing.

steps.player: I should probably wear my mourner disguise before doing that.

causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-se.text: You set fire to the food store.

causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-se.speaker: Woman
causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-se.text: You're burning the food! We need that food!

causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-se.player: We believe the food is contaminated with the plague. This is for your own safety.

causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-se.speaker: Woman
causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-se.text: We'll starve without it though! You can't do this!

causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-se.speaker: Woman
causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-se.text: I'll make sure everyone hears about this!

causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-ta.speaker: Chadwell
causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-ta.text: Good day. What can I get you?

options.text: I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.

steps.player: I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.

steps.speaker: Chadwell
steps.text: New taxes? What are you talking about?

steps.player: The plague isn't easy to contain. New funds are needed to help the effort.

steps.text: If the player is wearing a mourner's outfit:

steps.speaker: Chadwell
steps.text: But I barely make any money here. I can't afford to pay new taxes.

steps.player: Sorry, but the king himself gave the order. The first payment is due soon.

steps.speaker: Chadwell
steps.text: The people won't allow this to continue!
If the player is wearing Knight of Ardougne armour:

steps.speaker: Chadwell
steps.text: Hang on, I know you knights aren't allowed in West Ardougne. You're an imposter! Get out!

steps.player: I should probably wear my mourner disguise before doing that.

steps.text: If the player is not wearing either:

steps.speaker: Chadwell
steps.text: And why would a citizen be the one telling me this? Don't waste my time.

steps.player: I should probably wear my mourner disguise before doing that.

causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-se.text: You set fire to the food store.

causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-se.speaker: Clerk
causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-se.text: What do you think you're doing?

causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-se.player: The king has ordered us to burn this food. It could be contaminated with the plague.

causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-se.speaker: Clerk
causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-se.text: But that food is for the people. Without it they will starve!

causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-se.speaker: Clerk
causing-an-insurrection-west-ardougne-se.text: A lot of people are going to be angry about this!

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.speaker: Silk merchant
causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.text: I buy silk. If you ever want to sell any silk, bring it here.

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.player: I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.speaker: Silk merchant
causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.text: New taxes? What new taxes?

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.player: Taxes on all market stalls. The order comes from the king himself.

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.text: If the player is wearing Knight of Ardougne armour:

steps.speaker: Silk merchant
steps.text: Well I'll need to up my prices. A lot of people won't be happy about this.

steps.player: Probably not, but they'll just have to live with it. These taxes are needed for the good of the city. Someone will come to collect the tax from you soon.

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.text: If the player is wearing a mourner's outfit:

steps.speaker: Silk merchant
steps.text: The king wouldn't send a mourner to tell me this. Go away!

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.text: If the player is not wearing either:

steps.speaker: Silk merchant
steps.text: The king wouldn't send a citizen to tell me this. Go away!

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.speaker: Baker
causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.text: Good day [Sir/Madame]. Would you like some nice freshly baked bread? Or perhaps a nice piece of cake?

options.text: I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.

steps.player: I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.

steps.speaker: Baker
steps.text: What are you on about? New taxes?

steps.player: The plague isn't cheap to combat. The king has decreed that new taxes be introduced to help with the funding.

steps.text: If the player is wearing Knight of Ardougne armour:

steps.speaker: Baker
steps.text: I appreciate the need to combat the plague but this is a foolish move. My food feeds a lot of people, they'll be furious to hear about this.

steps.player: Better than getting the plague though. Your first payment is due soon, so you'd better be ready.

steps.text: If the player is wearing a mourner's outfit:

steps.text: You mourners may deal with the plague, but I know you have nothing to do with taxes. Now leave me alone!

steps.text: Citizens have nothing to do with taxes. Leave me alone!

steps.text: The food I provide helps to feed this city! People won't be happy when I have to increase my prices!

steps.player: Sorry, it's needed though. The first payment is due soon, make sure you're ready.

steps.text: Well that is unacceptable! I will have to increase my prices. I've produced silver for the king himself before but don't expect me to do that again!

steps.speaker: Fur trader
steps.text: His new castle market? So he's taxing us to help him set up a competing market? This is outrageous!

steps.player: Well he's the king so he can do what he wants. Your first payment will be collected soon.

steps.text: And he sent a mourner to inform us? Go away!

steps.text: And he sent a citizen to inform us? Go away!

options.text: I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.

steps.speaker: Spice seller
steps.text: A new market could put me out of business! Why should I help fund it?

steps.player: Because it's the law, refusing to pay is treason. Your first payment is due soon, so I suggest you prepare for it.

steps.text: A citizen wouldn't be sent to tell me this. Go away!

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.speaker: Town Crier
causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.text: Hear ye! Hear ye! Player Moderators massive help to RuneSc-

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.speaker: Town Crier
causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.text: Oh, hello citizen. Are you here to find out about Player Moderators? Or perhaps would you like to know about the laws of the land?

options.text: Tell me about the Rules of Conduct.
Could you help me tell people about some new taxes?

steps.player: Could you help me tell people about some new taxes?

steps.text: If the player is wearing Knight of Ardougne armour:

steps.speaker: Town Crier
steps.text: New taxes? You know that people won't be happy about that, right?

steps.player: I know, it's the king's orders though. The castle is in need of repairs and more funds are required.

steps.speaker: Town Crier
steps.text: As you wish, I will make sure the people know. Just know that I'll be sending them right to the king if they get angry.
If the player is wearing a mourner's outfit:

steps.speaker: Town Crier
steps.text: New taxes? I know that mourners don't have anything to do with taxes. Please allow me to get on with my work.
If the player is not wearing either:

steps.speaker: Town Crier
steps.text: New taxes? A citizen wouldn't have anything to do with taxes. Please allow me to get on with my work.

options.text: Can you give me a handy tip please?

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.speaker: Zenesha
causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.text: Hello there! I sell plate mail bodies, are you interested?

options.text: I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.

steps.player: I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.

steps.speaker: Zenesha
steps.text: I'm already paying my taxes though?

steps.player: These are new ones. They are to help pay for the king's upcoming visit to Great Kourend.

steps.text: If the player is wearing Knight of Ardougne armour:

steps.speaker: Zenesha
steps.text: Well I don't see why I have to pay for that! If the king can't afford the trip, then maybe he shouldn't be going!

steps.player: It's an important diplomatic trip I'm afraid so it has to go ahead. The first payment will be collected soon.

steps.text: If the player is wearing a mourner's outfit:

steps.speaker: Zenesha
steps.text: And he's getting a mourner to tell me this? Nice try.
If the player is not wearing either:

steps.speaker: Zenesha
steps.text: And he's getting a citizen to tell me this? Nice try.

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.speaker: Estate agent
causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.text: Hello. Welcome to the Gielinor Housing Agency! What can I do for you?

options.text: Can you move my house please?
Can you redecorate my house please?
I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.

steps.player: I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.

steps.speaker: Estate agent
steps.text: But the Gielinor Housing Agency doesn't pay taxes here! It's part of our business agreement with the king!

steps.player: These taxes are not included in that agreement. They're new emergency taxes related to the plague.

steps.text: If the player is wearing Knight of Ardougne armour:

steps.speaker: Estate agent
steps.text: Well this is just no good. If the king does not intend to honour his arrangement with us, we may well take our business elsewhere!

steps.player: You can do that, but while you're in Ardougne you must pay the tax. The first payment will be due soon.

steps.text: If the player is wearing a mourner's outfit:

steps.speaker: Estate agent
steps.text: And a mourner is the one telling me this. I don't think so.
If the player is not wearing either:

steps.speaker: Estate agent
steps.text: And a citizen is the one telling me this. I don't think so.

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.speaker: Probita
causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.text: Welcome to the pet insurance bureau. How can I help you?

options.text: I've lost a pet. Have you got it?
I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.

steps.player: I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.

steps.speaker: Probita
steps.text: What are you on about? I already pay my taxes.

steps.player: The king has ordered some new taxes to help fund his extensive collection of gnomish ornaments. Everyone has to contribute.

steps.text: If the player is wearing Knight of Ardougne armour:

steps.speaker: Probita
steps.text: Gnomish ornaments? Why can't the king pay for his own ornaments? He's got enough money as it is!

steps.player: The law has already been passed so it's not up for debate. Your first payment is expected soon.

steps.speaker: Probita
steps.text: I'll make sure people hear about this!
If the player is wearing a mourner's outfit:

steps.speaker: Probita
steps.text: And why would he send a mourner to tell me this? Stop lying and get out!
If the player is not wearing either:

steps.speaker: Probita
steps.text: And why would he send some random citizen to tell me this? Stop lying and get out!

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.speaker: Aemad/Kortan
causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.text: Hello there. You've come to the right place if you're looking for adventurer's equipment.

options.text: I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.

steps.player: I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.

steps.speaker: Aemad/Kortan
steps.text: New taxes? What new taxes?

steps.player: The castle is in dire need of repairs, the taxes are to help fund that. They've been ordered by the king himself.

steps.text: If the player is wearing Knight of Ardougne armour:

steps.speaker: Aemad/Kortan
steps.text: Ordered by the king? This is preposterous! We'll have to increase our prices to afford this, people will be furious!

steps.player: Sorry, but rules are rules. The first payment is due soon so make sure you're ready.

steps.text: If the player is wearing a mourner's outfit:

steps.speaker: Aemad/Kortan
steps.text: Ordered by the king? What a load of rubbish! You mourners seem to think you own the place. Well you don't! Now clear off!
If the player is not wearing either:

steps.speaker: Aemad/Kortan
steps.text: Ordered by the king? What a load of rubbish! I can see you're not one of his people. Stop fooling around and get lost!

options.text: No, I've come to the wrong place.

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.speaker: Priest
causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.text: Peace be with you, friend.

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.player: I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.speaker: Priest
causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.text: Taxes? But this is a holy church of Saradomin, we are exempt from taxes.

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.player: More funding is needed to hold back the plague. The church needs to help as well.

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.text: If the player is wearing Knight of Ardougne armour:

steps.speaker: Priest
steps.text: We'll need to use the donations from the congregation. We were hoping to use that money to build an orphanage for those who lost their parents to the plague.

steps.player: Sorry, but the king has given the order. The first payment is due soon.

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.text: If the player is wearing a mourner's outfit:

steps.speaker: Priest
steps.text: It is not the job of a mourner to deal with taxes. Now, if there's nothing else, I must get to work.

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.text: If the player is not wearing either:

steps.speaker: Priest
steps.text: It is not the job of a citizen to deal with taxes. Now, if there's nothing else, I must get to work.

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-re.speaker: Doctor Orbon
causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-re.text: Hello there. Can't stop to talk I'm afraid, I'm very busy right now.

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-re.player: I have some orders from the king for you.

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-re.text: If the player is wearing Knight of Ardougne armour:

steps.speaker: Doctor Orbon
steps.text: What are you on about?

steps.player: The king is concerned about the plague spreading. He has ordered that all doctors and nurses in the city retrain to ensure they are capable of dealing with the plague.

steps.speaker: Doctor Orbon
steps.text: Retrain? But that will take months! Who will help the people if there are no doctors around? This is a foolish move!

steps.player: Well the king's word is law so there's little point arguing.

steps.speaker: Doctor Orbon
steps.text: Well don't blame me when there's no one to help the king if he falls ill!

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-re.text: If the player is not wearing either:

steps.speaker: Doctor Orbon
steps.text: I don't take orders from citizens. Now I really must get to work.

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-re.text: If the player is wearing a mourner's outfit:

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.speaker: Bartender
causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.text: Would you like to buy a drink?

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.player: I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.speaker: Bartender
causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.text: Taxes? What do you mean?

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.player: By order of the king, all establishments such as this must now pay an extra beer tax.

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.text: If the player is wearing Knight of Ardougne armour:

steps.speaker: Bartender
steps.text: Beer tax? My patrons work hard for the city of Ardougne! They come here to unwind after a long day. This is plain disrespect to the work they do!

steps.player: It's also plain disrespect to defy the king's laws so you'd better be ready to pay up. We'll be back to collect soon.

steps.speaker: Bartender
steps.text: You haven't heard the last of this!

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.text: If the player is wearing a mourner's outfit:

steps.speaker: Bartender
steps.text: And why would a mourner be telling me this? Clear off!

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.text: If the player is not wearing either:

steps.speaker: Bartender
steps.text: You don't represent the king! Clear off!

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.player: I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.speaker: Richard
causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.text: New taxes? What for?

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.player: The king has ordered an increase in taxes on all farms in the area. It's due to a lack of care when it comes to the plague.

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.text: If the player is wearing Knight of Ardougne armour:

steps.speaker: Richard
steps.text: Lack of care? This is about Farmer Brumty and his sheep isn't it? That has nothing to do with us here! Why should we pay for his mistakes?

steps.player: Sorry, it's the word of the king so you'll have to pay up. The first instalment will be collected soon.

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.text: If the player is wearing a mourner's outfit:

steps.speaker: Richard
steps.text: You mourners may serve the king, but you don't have the power to enforce that. Go away!

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.text: If the player is not wearing either:

steps.speaker: Richard
steps.text: You don't have the power to enforce that. Go away!

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.player: I'm here to tell you about some new taxes.

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.speaker: Banker
causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.text: New taxes?

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.player: Yes, they've been ordered by the king to help him buy a new throne.

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.text: If the player is wearing Knight of Ardougne armour:

steps.speaker: Banker
steps.text: No problem. However, we first need to tax you for your bank usage.

steps.player: Wait... what?

steps.speaker: Banker
steps.text: Well it's only fair right? You tax us so we tax you.

steps.player: On second thoughts... forget I said anything.

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.text: If the player is wearing a mourner's outfit

steps.speaker: Banker
steps.text: Mourners don't deal with taxes. Nice try.

causing-an-insurrection-east-ardougne-ta.text: If the player is not wearing either:

steps.speaker: Banker
steps.text: Citizens don't deal with taxes. Nice try.

causing-an-insurrection-once-enough-peop.player: That should be enough people recruited, I'd better go and let Elena know.

vive-la-ardougne-r-volution-talking-to-a.speaker: Carla/Jethick/Kilron/Omart
vive-la-ardougne-r-volution-talking-to-a.text: Good work out there. You'd better speak to Elena and Councillor Halgrive, they'll go over the next steps with you.

vive-la-ardougne-r-volution-talking-to-e.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
vive-la-ardougne-r-volution-talking-to-e.text: Welcome back [player name], and good work out there. Thanks to you we now have a force that can stand up to Lathas and his armies.

vive-la-ardougne-r-volution-talking-to-e.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
vive-la-ardougne-r-volution-talking-to-e.text: Now comes the difficult part though. Before we move against the king, we need to deal with his allies, the mourners.

vive-la-ardougne-r-volution-talking-to-e.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
vive-la-ardougne-r-volution-talking-to-e.text: We now significantly outnumber the mourners, we should be able to drive them out of the city. The main focus will be their headquarters. Without their leadership, they'll soon retreat.

vive-la-ardougne-r-volution-talking-to-e.speaker: Elena
vive-la-ardougne-r-volution-talking-to-e.text: We have the numbers, but the mourners are better trained and better equipped. You should make sure you're ready before we begin. There will be bloodshed, on both sides.

options.text: Are you sure you're okay with this Elena?

steps.player: Are you sure you're okay with this Elena?

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: I don't like it, but I know it's the only way. I appreciate the concern though, thank you friend.

steps.player: It's necessary bloodshed though.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: It is, it's just a shame there isn't another way.

options.text: A bit of blood doesn't scare me.

steps.player: A bit of blood doesn't scare me.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: No... But you're not the one I'm worried about.

vive-la-ardougne-r-volution-talking-to-e.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
vive-la-ardougne-r-volution-talking-to-e.text: Are you ready to begin [player name]?
You are about to begin the Battle of West Ardougne. Any items left in the battle, including upon death, will be lost.

steps.player: I'm ready.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: I will send word around to make sure our people are prepared. Good luck everyone.

steps.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
steps.text: This is it! The plague of West Ardougne has gone on for long enough, today is the day of plague's end!

battle-of-two-ardougnes-west-ardougne-af.speaker: Elena
battle-of-two-ardougnes-west-ardougne-af.text: Good work! Let's head downstairs and deal with the rest of them!

battle-of-two-ardougnes-west-ardougne-up.speaker: Essyllt
battle-of-two-ardougnes-west-ardougne-up.text: You! I knew you were trouble! Well don't worry, Lord Iorwerth will learn of your betrayal!

battle-of-two-ardougnes-west-ardougne-af.speaker: Elena
battle-of-two-ardougnes-west-ardougne-af.text: We did it! Now we'd better get out of here!

battle-of-two-ardougnes-west-ardougne-re.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
battle-of-two-ardougnes-west-ardougne-re.text: Excellent work with those mourners. I suspect the king might be getting a little worried now.

battle-of-two-ardougnes-west-ardougne-re.speaker: Elena
battle-of-two-ardougnes-west-ardougne-re.text: We'll need to move fast. He's probably already planning his retaliation.

battle-of-two-ardougnes-west-ardougne-re.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
battle-of-two-ardougnes-west-ardougne-re.text: He'll likely expect us to take some time to recuperate after that battle. He won't expect us to hit him right away.

battle-of-two-ardougnes-west-ardougne-re.player: So let me guess, that's exactly what we're going to do?

battle-of-two-ardougnes-west-ardougne-re.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
battle-of-two-ardougnes-west-ardougne-re.text: Indeed, we hit the castle now before they have a proper chance to prepare for us.

battle-of-two-ardougnes-west-ardougne-re.player: Even if they're not prepared, the castle will still be well defended.

battle-of-two-ardougnes-west-ardougne-re.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
battle-of-two-ardougnes-west-ardougne-re.text: Yes, but thanks to our victory in West Ardougne, some of the knights are starting to question their loyalties. I've taken advantage of this and made arrangements to ensure the gates are open to us.

battle-of-two-ardougnes-west-ardougne-re.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
battle-of-two-ardougnes-west-ardougne-re.text: Make no mistake, it will still be a tough fight, but it's a fight we should be able to win.

battle-of-two-ardougnes-west-ardougne-re.speaker: Elena
battle-of-two-ardougnes-west-ardougne-re.text: We can afford to take a little bit of time to ensure everyone has resupplied so feel free to come back later if you're not ready yet. Just don't take too long.

battle-of-two-ardougnes-west-ardougne-re.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
battle-of-two-ardougnes-west-ardougne-re.text: Let me know when you are ready to begin [player name].
You are about to begin the Battle of East Ardougne. Any items left in the battle, including upon death, will be lost.

steps.player: I'm ready.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: I never thought this day would come. We're finally going to deal with that traitor once and for all!

steps.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
steps.text: Let's show him what it means to cross the people of Ardougne!

battle-of-two-ardougnes-east-ardougne-af.speaker: Elena
battle-of-two-ardougnes-east-ardougne-af.text: Look's like that's the last of them! Good work everyone!

battle-of-two-ardougnes-it-s-treason-the.speaker: Omart
battle-of-two-ardougnes-it-s-treason-the.text: Look who we found hiding in a wardrobe.

battle-of-two-ardougnes-it-s-treason-the.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
battle-of-two-ardougnes-it-s-treason-the.text: So you're a coward as well as a traitor! What a pathetic excuse of a man you are.

battle-of-two-ardougnes-it-s-treason-the.speaker: King Lathas
battle-of-two-ardougnes-it-s-treason-the.text: You call me a traitor? I am your king! The traitors here are the ones standing before me.

battle-of-two-ardougnes-it-s-treason-the.speaker: Elena
battle-of-two-ardougnes-it-s-treason-the.text: Give it a rest, it's over. We know the truth.

battle-of-two-ardougnes-it-s-treason-the.speaker: King Lathas
battle-of-two-ardougnes-it-s-treason-the.text: And what truth might that be?

battle-of-two-ardougnes-it-s-treason-the.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
battle-of-two-ardougnes-it-s-treason-the.text: You let an enemy into our city and covered it up by lying to your people.

battle-of-two-ardougnes-it-s-treason-the.speaker: King Lathas
battle-of-two-ardougnes-it-s-treason-the.text: And I'm sure you'd never do something like that. Don't think I didn't hear about the lies you spread about me.

battle-of-two-ardougnes-it-s-treason-the.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
battle-of-two-ardougnes-it-s-treason-the.text: There's also your brother. Murdered on your orders.

battle-of-two-ardougnes-it-s-treason-the.speaker: King Lathas
battle-of-two-ardougnes-it-s-treason-the.text: You are aware that his killer stands with you, are you not?

battle-of-two-ardougnes-it-s-treason-the.speaker: Elena
battle-of-two-ardougnes-it-s-treason-the.text: [player name] is innocent in this. You manipulated them for your own gain.

battle-of-two-ardougnes-it-s-treason-the.speaker: King Lathas
battle-of-two-ardougnes-it-s-treason-the.text: Oh don't you go pretending they're innocent! They're nothing more than a mercenary. All they care about is the big pot of gold at the end.

battle-of-two-ardougnes-it-s-treason-the.speaker: King Lathas
battle-of-two-ardougnes-it-s-treason-the.text: They betrayed me! Before long, they'll betray you as well!

battle-of-two-ardougnes-it-s-treason-the.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
battle-of-two-ardougnes-it-s-treason-the.text: Enough! You're finished Lathas. The people will decide your fate. I don't expect them to be kind.

battle-of-two-ardougnes-it-s-treason-the.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
battle-of-two-ardougnes-it-s-treason-the.text: [player name], do you have any questions for the king before we take him away? I suspect you won't get another chance to ask them.

options.text: Why were you helping Lord Iorwerth?

steps.player: Why were you helping Lord Iorwerth?

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: My father, King Ulthas, once ruled over a united Kandarin. I was his eldest son, the kingdom was my birthright! But my fool of a father took that from me.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: When King Arthur and his knights arrived in our lands, my father granted them the castle of Camelot, ousting the loyal subjects that previously lived there.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Not only that, but he also declared that the kingdom be jointly ruled by my brother and I, rather than giving it to me as he should have.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: When I ascended to my half-throne, I promised myself that I would unite this kingdom again, no matter the cost.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: That's why I made the deal with Lord Iorwerth. In return for access to West Ardougne, he agreed to help me kill my brother and drive out King Arthur.

options.text: Did you know what the mourners were doing?

steps.player: Did you know what the mourners were doing?

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: In West Ardougne? They were searching for some sort of temple. According to Lord Iorwerth, the power there would be essential in summoning Zamorak, the Dark Lord.

steps.player: So you knowingly allied with a group of Zamorakians?

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Of course I did! I prayed to Saradomin that he would help unite my kingdom again. He chose not to reply. I turned to the Dark Lord instead.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: With Zamorak at my side, nothing would stand between me and Camelot!

options.text: Why did you kill your brother?

steps.player: Why did you kill your brother?

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Last I checked it was you that killed him, not me.

steps.player: You know what I mean.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: My brother was never meant to rule. The kingdom was mine by birthright! My father chose to give him half the kingdom, and he did a terrible job ruling it.

steps.speaker: King Lathas
steps.text: Have you seen West Ardougne? The city is a mess, and not because of the plague. That was my brother's doing. I may be a bad person, but make no mistake, my brother was no hero either.

options.text: We're done here, take him away.

steps.player: We're done here, take him away.

battle-of-two-ardougnes-killing-of-a-kin.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
battle-of-two-ardougnes-killing-of-a-kin.text: Citizens of Ardougne! Before you stands Lathas Ardignas: a traitor, a murderer and a liar!

battle-of-two-ardougnes-killing-of-a-kin.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
battle-of-two-ardougnes-killing-of-a-kin.text: He has been found guilty of numerous heinous crimes, and will now face judgement for his sins!

battle-of-two-ardougnes-killing-of-a-kin.speaker: Elena
battle-of-two-ardougnes-killing-of-a-kin.text: So this is it. After all this time, Lathas is finally going to pay for what he's done. It's like I should feel something, but I just feel empty.

battle-of-two-ardougnes-killing-of-a-kin.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
battle-of-two-ardougnes-killing-of-a-kin.text: Lathas Ardignas, as decided by the people of Ardougne, you are hereby sentenced to death!

battle-of-two-ardougnes-killing-of-a-kin.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
battle-of-two-ardougnes-killing-of-a-kin.text: Do you have any final words?

battle-of-two-ardougnes-killing-of-a-kin.speaker: Lathas
battle-of-two-ardougnes-killing-of-a-kin.text: How dare you insult me like this! You can't kill me! I am the rightful king! Every person here is under my rule!

battle-of-two-ardougnes-killing-of-a-kin.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
battle-of-two-ardougnes-killing-of-a-kin.text: The people have passed their judgement, you are not a king any more.

battle-of-two-ardougnes-killing-of-a-kin.speaker: Lathas
battle-of-two-ardougnes-killing-of-a-kin.text: Then you are all traitors, and you will all pay with your lives!

battle-of-two-ardougnes-killing-of-a-kin.speaker: Lathas
battle-of-two-ardougnes-killing-of-a-kin.text: In the name of Zamorak I curse you, each and every one of you!
Lathas is killed by the executioner, and two Hooded Figures knock the player and Elena out.

battle-of-two-ardougnes-killing-of-a-kin.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
battle-of-two-ardougnes-killing-of-a-kin.text: Well hello again adventurer! How are you today?

battle-of-two-ardougnes-killing-of-a-kin.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
battle-of-two-ardougnes-killing-of-a-kin.text: Not too bad, I've a lot to do though. King Lathas left plenty of things for us to clean up.

battle-of-two-ardougnes-killing-of-a-kin.speaker: King Thoros
battle-of-two-ardougnes-killing-of-a-kin.text: On behalf of everyone in Ardougne, I thank you for your help adventurer. I'm afraid I don't have time to talk, my predecessor has left me with a lot of work to do.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: So you finally decided to show your true colours, how disappointing.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Essyllt
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: We should have killed them both when we had the chance.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: Hmm, perhaps.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: You know, after you killed King Tyras, I thought you might have some potential. Given time, we might have properly welcomed you into our ranks. You'd have been the first human among us.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.player: Well I'm glad to have disappointed you. I don't work with murderers.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: No? You seemed more than happy to kill King Tyras when it suited you. Burnt him alive in the middle of his own camp if I recall.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Elena
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: [player name] is innocent! You lied to them!

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: Lied? I told your friend here that King Tyras was an invader into our lands. Last time I checked, that was the truth.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.player: Maybe, but you conveniently missed out the part about you trying to summon the Dark Lord.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: Ah, I see you have been led astray. You think we are the evil ones, but our cause is the true one. You think we are murderers, but we are in fact saviours.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: You think you're the hero of this story, but you're not...

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Elena
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: You're mad!

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Essyllt
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: Let me deal with them, my lord. They've caused us enough trouble.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: They may still be of use to us. Lock them away for now. Give them time to think on their choices.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Essyllt
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: Hmm, as you wish.
Arianwyn and several Rebel Archers appear, killing some of the Iorwerth soldiers.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Arianwyn
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: That's enough Lord Iorwerth, let them go!

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: Brave of you to come here Arianwyn, but foolish. We have you outnumbered.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Arianwyn
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: Don't be so sure. We fight with the strength of ten of your warriors.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: Perhaps, but I don't believe you're the type to throw lives away without need. Instead, why don't we discuss this like reasonable people.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Arianwyn
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: We don't have anything to discuss with you, you Zamorakian scum!

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: Zamorakian? You don't really think we'd support that monster do you? I'm afraid to say that you're quite mistaken.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Arianwyn
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: Don't try to manipulate us with your lies. We know all about your plot with King Lathas to summon the Dark Lord.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: Ah, that. Well now that King Lathas is dead, I suppose there's no better time to reveal the truth.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: It was just a ruse I'm afraid. A lie we told King Lathas to get him on our side.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Arianwyn
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: What are you on about?

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: We needed access to West Ardougne so we needed the support of the king. Once we found out about his hidden worship of Zamorak, it seemed like an obvious lie to tell.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: I have no more love for Zamorak than you do. I've only ever served one god, the same one as you, Seren.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Arianwyn
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: You're lying! You wanted to use the Temple of Light to summon Zamorak!

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: I can see why you'd think that, but you are mistaken. You're right to say that the temple is key to summoning a god, but that god is not Zamorak, it's Seren.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Arianwyn
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: That's impossible! Seren is dead!

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: I thought the same once. That was until I managed to break one of the seals within the Grand Library.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: That's how I discovered the truth. A part of Seren lives on, trapped within the Temple of Light.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Arianwyn
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: I don't believe you!

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: A shame. You're better than this Arianwyn, I hope in time you will see that.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Morvran
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: What should we do with them, my lord.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: Let them go. Let it be known that the Iorwerth clan is not without mercy.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Essyllt
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: Are you sure about this?

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: Yes. But make no mistake Arianwyn, if you and your rebels interfere with our affairs again, I will not be so forgiving.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: Now, I suggest you leave, before I change my mind.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Arianwyn
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: This isn't over!
The player, Elena, Arianwyn and the rebels leave.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Essyllt
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: This is a bad idea.

face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
face-to-face-with-lord-iorwerth.text: Don't be so sure. They may not know it yet, but the rebels could be of great use to us...

retreating-to-lletya.speaker: Arianwyn
retreating-to-lletya.text: Ah [player name], there you are. We thought it best to let you rest for a bit after everything that happened earlier.

retreating-to-lletya.player: Thanks Arianwyn, I definitely needed it. And thank you for saving us back there, I don't know what we'd have done if you hadn't shown up.

retreating-to-lletya.speaker: Arianwyn
retreating-to-lletya.text: I suspect you wouldn't have been around to have this conversation. You played a dangerous game in Ardougne. I fear you may not have considered the outcome of that.

retreating-to-lletya.player: People were dying Arianwyn, we couldn't do nothing.

retreating-to-lletya.speaker: Arianwyn
retreating-to-lletya.text: Of course not, but we have no idea how Lord Iorwerth will respond to this. The things he said when we freed you were... concerning...

retreating-to-lletya.player: You can say that again. What do you think he meant by it all?

retreating-to-lletya.speaker: Arianwyn
retreating-to-lletya.text: I'm not sure. It's something that we should discuss with the others.

retreating-to-lletya.speaker: Arianwyn
retreating-to-lletya.text: Could you do me a favour and fetch Ysgawyn. He's probably on the upper platforms. You should bring your friend Elena as well. I'm not sure where she is I'm afraid, Ysgawyn might know though.

retreating-to-lletya-fetching-ysgawyn.speaker: Ysgawyn
retreating-to-lletya-fetching-ysgawyn.text: I am, what of it human?

retreating-to-lletya-fetching-ysgawyn.player: Arianwyn has called a meeting. He asked me to come fetch you.

retreating-to-lletya-fetching-ysgawyn.speaker: Ysgawyn
retreating-to-lletya-fetching-ysgawyn.text: I see, so now I'm meant to follow the orders of a human.

retreating-to-lletya-fetching-ysgawyn.player: It wasn't an order, it was just...

retreating-to-lletya-fetching-ysgawyn.speaker: Ysgawyn
retreating-to-lletya-fetching-ysgawyn.text: Make no mistake human, you may have Arianwyn and the others fooled but I know what you are.

retreating-to-lletya-fetching-ysgawyn.player: I don't know what you mean...

retreating-to-lletya-fetching-ysgawyn.speaker: Ysgawyn
retreating-to-lletya-fetching-ysgawyn.text: You're a menace. You claim you're here to help, but everywhere you go you leave a trail of bodies behind.

retreating-to-lletya-fetching-ysgawyn.speaker: Ysgawyn
retreating-to-lletya-fetching-ysgawyn.text: Anyway, I'll come to this meeting, I'm in no place to deny Arianwyn. Just stay out of my way from here on out.

retreating-to-lletya-fetching-ysgawyn.player: Fine. Before you go, do you know where Elena is?

retreating-to-lletya-fetching-ysgawyn.speaker: Ysgawyn
retreating-to-lletya-fetching-ysgawyn.text: The other human? I think she's by the pond to the south west. Now if you'll excuse me...

retreating-to-lletya-fetching-elena.player: So how are you doing, Elena?

retreating-to-lletya-fetching-elena.speaker: Elena
retreating-to-lletya-fetching-elena.text: I'm okay. So much has happened so fast, it's a lot to take in.

options.text: It is. I'm here for you if you need me though.

steps.player: It is. I'm here for you if you need me though.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Thanks, that means a lot.

steps.player: You'll get used to it.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: I guess... I just don't know if I want to.

steps.player: Yeah, it's no small thing.

retreating-to-lletya-fetching-elena.speaker: Elena
retreating-to-lletya-fetching-elena.text: Anyway, I wanted to ask you something.

steps.player: Go ahead.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: The people of Ardougne, the elves here, you've spent a lot of time helping them. Why? What drives you, [player name]?

steps.player: I care about helping people.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: So even if you knew that you'd get nothing out of it yourself, you'd still continue to help these elves?

steps.player: Of course.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: I suspect not many people would feel that way.

steps.player: Well I'm not like other people.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Clearly. Thank you for answering, I realise it's a pretty pointless question. I was curious to know how you felt though.

options.text: Well a reward's always nice, but yes.

steps.player: Well a reward's always nice, but yes.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: I guess it's always nice to be rewarded. It's good to know that isn't all that matters to you though. I suspect not many people would feel that way.

steps.player: Well I'm not like other people.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Clearly. Thank you for answering, I realise it's a pretty pointless question. I was curious to know how you felt though.

options.text: Actually, I think I'd want a reward.

steps.player: Actually, I think I'd want a reward.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: I guess it's always nice to be rewarded. You should be careful not to let that drive you though. Money can't buy everything, [player name].

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Well I've rambled on enough. Was there something you needed?

steps.player: Arianwyn has called a meeting. He'd like you to attend.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: I'd better head over there then.
Elena leaves for the meeting.

options.text: People reward me for helping them.

steps.player: People reward me for helping them.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: So if you didn't think you'd get a reward, you'd stop helping these elves?

options.text: Yes, the reward is what matters.

steps.player: Yes, the reward is what matters.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: You should be careful of letting that drive you. Money can't buy everything, [player name].

options.text: Actually, I think I'd still help.

steps.player: Actually, I think I'd still help.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: So it's not just about the reward after all. It's nice to know that isn't all that matters to you. I suspect not many people would feel that way.

steps.player: Well I'm not like other people.

steps.text: Clearly. Thank you for answering, I realise it's a pretty pointless question. I was curious to know how you felt though.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Well I've rambled on enough. Was there something you needed?

steps.player: Arianwyn has called a meeting. He'd like you to attend.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: I'd better head over there then.
Elena leaves for the meeting.

options.text: I need to fix my mistakes.

steps.player: I need to fix my mistakes.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: So it's about what happened with King Tyras? Do you think you'd still help these elves if that hadn't happened?

steps.player: I think so.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: So it's not just guilt that's driving you, that's good to know. What happened with King Tyras was awful but you can't take too much blame, Lathas manipulated you.

options.text: No, I don't think I would.

steps.player: No, I don't think I would.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: So the only thing driving you is guilt? That doesn't seem healthy. Be careful that you don't carry the world on your shoulders, [player name]. It's not your fault that Lathas manipulated you.

steps.player: I'm not sure.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Hmmm, not something you've had to think about I guess. Just make sure that you don't carry the world on your shoulders, [player name]. It's not your fault that Lathas manipulated you.

steps.player: I know, thanks Elena.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Anyway, I've rambled on enough. Was there something you needed?

steps.player: Arianwyn has called a meeting. He'd like you to attend.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: I'd better head over there then. Thanks for the talk.
Elena leaves for the meeting.

options.text: It's my duty to help people.

steps.player: It's my duty to help people.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Be careful of hiding behind duty, it won't stop people holding you accountable for your actions.

steps.player: I'm not sure.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Hmmm, not something you've had to think about I guess. It's worth considering though. We should all have something to drive us.
