the-first-meeting-talking-to-elena.speaker: Elena
the-first-meeting-talking-to-elena.text: Hey [player name]. You should talk to Arianwyn when you're ready to begin.

the-first-meeting-talking-to-ysgawyn.player: Hey, I wanted to ask you...

the-first-meeting-talking-to-ysgawyn.speaker: Ysgawyn
the-first-meeting-talking-to-ysgawyn.text: No. Go away and talk to Arianwyn instead.

the-first-meeting-talking-to-ilfeen.speaker: Ilfeen
the-first-meeting-talking-to-ilfeen.text: Hey there. You should let Arianwyn know once you're ready to get started.

the-first-meeting-talking-to-eluned.speaker: Eluned
the-first-meeting-talking-to-eluned.text: Hey there [player name]. Arianwyn's leading this meeting so you should let him know when you're ready to start.

the-first-meeting-talking-to-islwyn.speaker: Islwyn
the-first-meeting-talking-to-islwyn.text: Good to see you [player name]. You should speak to Arianwyn when you're ready to begin.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Arianwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: Right, now that we're all here, let's get started.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Arianwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: So, as I'm sure you've all heard, King Lathas of Ardougne is dead. He was overthrown by his subjects and executed soon afterwards.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Arianwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: That's not all though, the mourners of West Ardougne have been driven out of the city. Lord Iorwerth no longer has any presence in Ardougne.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Ysgawyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: Let's not ignore the obvious, Arianwyn. Our supposed ally, [player name], helped lead the uprising. His actions may well have endangered us all.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Ilfeen
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: But surely this is a good thing? With Ardougne lost to him, Lord Iorwerth no longer has access to the Temple of Light. Without that, he has no way to summon the Dark Lord.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Ysgawyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: The temple was already secure. All this uprising has achieved is to anger the enemy.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Islwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: You say that like it's a bad thing, Ysgawyn. Last time I checked, we didn't care about upsetting our foe.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Ysgawyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: I care about keeping our people alive, Islwyn!

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Elena
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: And what about our people? While you sat here in your secure little village, we took action! We saved lives! But I guess you're too selfish to care about us.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Ysgawyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: Selfish? How dare you! You know nothing of the plight of the elves, girl. You'd do well to keep your mouth shut!

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Arianwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: That's enough Ysgawyn. We can debate what's happened for days and still reach no conclusion. That is not why I called you all here. Instead, we need to plan what happens next.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Arianwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: Now, while freeing [player name] and Elena from the Iorwerth camp, we were confronted by Lord Iorwerth. He could have killed us all, but he let us go.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Eluned
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: He let you go? Why?

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Arianwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: His reasoning was disturbing. For a long time now, we've believed that Lord Iorwerth has been trying to summon Zamorak, the Dark Lord. However, he claimed otherwise.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Ilfeen
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: But if not Zamorak, then who?

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Arianwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: Seren.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Eluned
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: Seren? But that's impossible, Seren is gone.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Arianwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: He seems to think otherwise. He claimed that a part of Seren still lives, trapped within the Temple of Light. Apparently, he discovered this by breaking one of the nine seals within the Grand Library.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Islwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: That's impossible. He must be lying.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Elena
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: Sorry, but I don't understand what you mean by all of this. Who's Seren? What library?

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Eluned
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: Seren was our goddess, our guardian and our teacher. Everything we have, we owe to her. She helped us build the great city of Prifddinas, a place where all elves could live in harmony.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Ilfeen
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: At the end of the God Wars, the gods were banished from this world. Seren didn't want to leave us though, she couldn't. She shattered herself into thousands of crystals. Those crystals are all we have left of her now.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Elena
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: I see, I'm sorry to hear that.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Arianwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: As for the Grand Library, it was a great archive of knowledge beneath Prifddinas. Pretty much everything there was open to all of elven kind.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Arianwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: There was an exception to that though, the nine seals of Seren. The seals guarded the forbidden knowledge, that which only Seren herself could access.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.player: And Lord Iorwerth managed to break one of these seals.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Ysgawyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: So he claims...

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Elena
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: Is there no way we can check?

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Islwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: No. Prifddinas was lost to us. When Lord Iorwerth first took control of the city, my grandfather, Baxtorian, led an army to try and stop him.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Islwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: When that failed, Baxtorian and the other clan elders made one final ditch attempt to save Prifddinas. They sung the song of inversion to revert the entire city to a crystal seed.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Arianwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: Their plan worked, and the city was lost to Lord Iorwerth. However, it was lost to the rest of us as well, the Grand Library with it.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Elena
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: What happened to Baxtorian?

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Islwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: While he was fighting Lord Iorwerth, invaders took control of our kingdom to the east. They kidnapped Glarial, Baxtorian's wife.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Islwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: Unable to find her, he sealed himself beneath the waterfall where they lived, never to be seen again.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.player: Baxtorian was king of the elves back then. Do you think he had access to the forbidden knowledge?

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Islwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: It's not impossible I suppose. If anyone, it would have been him. Baxtorian was closer to Seren than any other elf, it's one of the reasons he was chosen to become king.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Ysgawyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: Baxtorian is gone though, even if he knew something, he can't help us now.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Islwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: Don't be so sure. I never knew my grandfather, but my mother always told me that he wasn't the type for taking chances. If he knew something important, he'd have made sure it wouldn't have been lost with him.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Arianwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: We can't possibly make a plan without knowing Lord Iorwerth's intentions. While unlikely to be true, this stuff about the library is all we have to go on.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Arianwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: If Baxtorian left behind anything that could help us, we should try to find it.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Islwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: Baxtorian kept everything of importance to him at his home within Baxtorian Falls. If we're going to find anything, it's probably there.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Arianwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: [player name], you've been to Baxtorian Falls multiple times. You're the best person to take the lead on this.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Ysgawyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: You trust the human with this?

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Islwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: Let go of your pride, Ysgawyn. [player name] has proven his worth to us.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Arianwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: I'd like to accompany you on this one [player name], it might be useful to have an elf with you.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Islwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: Before her death, my mother passed down a book to me. It was written by my grandfather for his wife. You should take it with you. It might contain something of use.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Arianwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: Thank you Islwyn. While we're gone, the rest of you should focus on Lord Iorwerth. See if you can get any idea on what he's planning now that he's lost Ardougne. Just be careful.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Eluned
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: We always are. Good luck to you both.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Arianwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: And you. Let's get started.
The others leave the meeting.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Arianwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: Thank you for agreeing to help us, [player name]. We owe a lot to you, even if some of us don't show it very well.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.player: You mean Ysgawyn? He is a bit rude.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Arianwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: Try not to be too judgemental. Ysgawyn's husband was killed by Essyllt, one of Lord Iorwerth's henchmen. Ysgawyn's never really been the same since.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.player: I've met Essyllt, he was the one in charge of the mourners in West Ardougne.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Arianwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: He's a nasty piece of work. If you try hard enough, you can find something redeemable about most elves, even those that serve Lord Iorwerth.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Arianwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: But Essyllt... He seems to take joy in the suffering of others, especially those unable to defend themselves.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Arianwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: Enough about him though, we need to focus on Baxtorian Falls. I suggest we travel seperately, we can't be too careful at the moment.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.player: Makes sense, will you be okay getting there on your own?

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.speaker: Arianwyn
the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.text: I'm no expert on your lands but I should be fine. I just have a few things to gather before I depart.

the-first-meeting-the-first-meeting-begi.player: Well in that case, I'll meet you there.

the-first-meeting-talking-to-arianwyn-af.speaker: Arianwyn
the-first-meeting-talking-to-arianwyn-af.text: I just have a few things to gather before I depart for Baxtorian Falls. I'll meet you there.

the-first-meeting-talking-to-elena-after.speaker: Elena
the-first-meeting-talking-to-elena-after.text: Hey [player name]. Good to see you.

the-first-meeting-talking-to-elena-after.speaker: Elena
the-first-meeting-talking-to-elena-after.text: Pretty good. I've been thinking about that elf, Ysgawyn.

the-first-meeting-talking-to-elena-after.player: Bit of an angry guy isn't he?

the-first-meeting-talking-to-elena-after.speaker: Elena
the-first-meeting-talking-to-elena-after.text: That's one way to put it. I can't say I approve of his attitude, but I appreciate he's seen a lot in this war.

the-first-meeting-talking-to-elena-after.speaker: Elena
the-first-meeting-talking-to-elena-after.text: It's interesting, the elves have such long lifespans, we're just children compared to them. And yet, even with all their experience, they're still just as fickle as we are.

the-first-meeting-talking-to-elena-after.player: I find most races are the same to be honest.

the-first-meeting-talking-to-elena-after.speaker: Elena
the-first-meeting-talking-to-elena-after.text: Anyway, had any luck with Baxtorian Falls?

the-first-meeting-talking-to-elena-after.speaker: Elena
the-first-meeting-talking-to-elena-after.text: I'll let you crack on then. We'll talk more later.

the-first-meeting-talking-to-ysgawyn-aft.player: Hey, I wanted to ask you...

visiting-baxtorian-falls-talking-to-aria.speaker: Arianwyn
visiting-baxtorian-falls-talking-to-aria.text: Hello there [player name], glad to see you made it here okay.

visiting-baxtorian-falls-talking-to-aria.speaker: Arianwyn
visiting-baxtorian-falls-talking-to-aria.text: I must say, it feels strange to be back here, especially after all of this time.

visiting-baxtorian-falls-talking-to-aria.speaker: Arianwyn
visiting-baxtorian-falls-talking-to-aria.text: I was one of the elves born in Baxtorian's new kingdom. My family were close relations of Baxtorian, he invited us here a few times.

visiting-baxtorian-falls-talking-to-aria.speaker: Arianwyn
visiting-baxtorian-falls-talking-to-aria.text: Those were simpler times, happier times. After Baxtorian left to try and retake Prifddinas, my parents were among those who joined him. They never returned. I was still just a child at the time, alone and afraid.

visiting-baxtorian-falls-talking-to-aria.player: I'm sorry to hear that Arianwyn.

visiting-baxtorian-falls-talking-to-aria.speaker: Arianwyn
visiting-baxtorian-falls-talking-to-aria.text: This war has taken so much... From my people, and from yours. I'd give anything to see peace, anything to finally see Prifddinas with my own eyes.

visiting-baxtorian-falls-talking-to-aria.speaker: Arianwyn
visiting-baxtorian-falls-talking-to-aria.text: Sorry, now's not the time for this. We need to see if Baxtorian left anything of use behind.

visiting-baxtorian-falls-talking-to-aria.speaker: Arianwyn
visiting-baxtorian-falls-talking-to-aria.text: Here's that book that Islwyn gave us. Hopefully it has something of use in it.
If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: Arianwyn tries to give you a book but you don't have enough room to take it.

visiting-baxtorian-falls-talking-to-aria.text: If the player has inventory space:

steps.text: Arianwyn gives you a book.

options.text: Do you believe what Lord Iorwerth said about Seren?

steps.player: Do you believe what Lord Iorwerth said about Seren?

steps.speaker: Arianwyn
steps.text: To be honest... I really don't know. It seems impossible, and yet...

steps.speaker: Arianwyn
steps.text: No. It's just me being wishful. He's lying, he has to be.

steps.player: Wishful?

steps.speaker: Arianwyn
steps.text: By the time I was born, Seren was already gone from this world. All I know of her is the stories my parents told me.

steps.player: You wish you could have met her?

steps.speaker: Arianwyn
steps.text: I do, but that doesn't mean I should fall for the lies of Lord Iorwerth. Seren is gone, nothing can ever bring her back.

options.text: Do you think we'll find anything to help us here?

steps.player: Do you think we'll find anything to help us here?

steps.speaker: Arianwyn
steps.text: I won't lie, we're clutching straws here. We have nothing else to go on though, so we have to try.

steps.speaker: Arianwyn
steps.text: Baxtorian was once king of the elves, anything he left behind might be of use.

steps.player: I'll crack on.

visiting-baxtorian-falls-talking-to-aria.speaker: Arianwyn
visiting-baxtorian-falls-talking-to-aria.text: We need to see if Baxtorian left anything of use behind. Maybe that book will be of use.

options.text: Do you believe what Lord Iorwerth said about Seren?
Do you think we'll find anything to help us here?

visiting-baxtorian-falls-baxtorian-lives.player: I'm [player name] and this is Arianwyn.

visiting-baxtorian-falls-baxtorian-lives.speaker: Baxtorian
visiting-baxtorian-falls-baxtorian-lives.text: Arianwyn... I remember that name. You grew up in my kingdom... I'm sorry about your family.

visiting-baxtorian-falls-baxtorian-lives.speaker: Baxtorian
visiting-baxtorian-falls-baxtorian-lives.text: I appreciate the sentiment, but please, I am no king anymore.

visiting-baxtorian-falls-baxtorian-lives.speaker: Baxtorian
visiting-baxtorian-falls-baxtorian-lives.text: Now I must ask... Glarial... Is there any news?

visiting-baxtorian-falls-baxtorian-lives.speaker: Baxtorian
visiting-baxtorian-falls-baxtorian-lives.text: I... I see... It was always a lot to hope for...

visiting-baxtorian-falls-baxtorian-lives.speaker: Arianwyn
visiting-baxtorian-falls-baxtorian-lives.text: If it's any consolation, [player name] moved her remains here, to be closer to you.

visiting-baxtorian-falls-baxtorian-lives.speaker: Baxtorian
visiting-baxtorian-falls-baxtorian-lives.text: That... That means a lot. Thank you. It is good to see that some humans still see elves as friends.

visiting-baxtorian-falls-baxtorian-lives.speaker: Baxtorian
visiting-baxtorian-falls-baxtorian-lives.text: No... I feel I've spent long enough here.

visiting-baxtorian-falls-baxtorian-lives.speaker: Arianwyn
visiting-baxtorian-falls-baxtorian-lives.text: Then I can take you back to Lletya. Your grandson, Islwyn, is there.

visiting-baxtorian-falls-baxtorian-lives.speaker: Baxtorian
visiting-baxtorian-falls-baxtorian-lives.text: Grandson? So Eirlys had a child? Does she still live as well?

visiting-baxtorian-falls-baxtorian-lives.speaker: Baxtorian
visiting-baxtorian-falls-baxtorian-lives.text: No father should outlive their child. Forgive me Eirlys.

visiting-baxtorian-falls-baxtorian-lives.speaker: Baxtorian
visiting-baxtorian-falls-baxtorian-lives.text: Please, let us leave now. There is too much sadness for me here, too much pain. Once we arrive, you must tell me everything that has happened in my absence.

visiting-baxtorian-falls-baxtorian-lives.speaker: Arianwyn
visiting-baxtorian-falls-baxtorian-lives.text: Very well, I will teleport us back to Lletya. You'll have to make your own way back I'm afraid, [player name].
Arianwyn teleports himself and Baxtorian back to Lletya.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: Oh... Hello there. You'd probably best talk to Arianwyn.

options.text: I'd like to ask you something about yourself.

steps.player: I'd like to ask you something about yourself.

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: I see... Go ahead.

options.text: Why did you seal yourself away?

steps.player: Why did you seal yourself away?

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: My Glarial... She mattered more to me than anything else, but she was lost to me. The enemy took her, so I searched far and wide to find her again.

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: At times I came close, but in the end, I was too weak to carry on. I knew there was a chance she may live though, so I sealed myself away, hoping she would be the one to wake me.

steps.player: I see. I'm sorry.

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: I thank you friend, but please, don't be. The burden is mine to bear.

options.text: What happened between you and Lord Iorwerth?

steps.player: What happened between you and Lord Iorwerth?

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: To be honest, even today I know little of him. When I left Prifddinas to expand our kingdom into the east, he was but a child, with the Iorwerth clan ruled by his mother.

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: The first time I properly met him was after I heard about his takeover of the city. I led my forces through the Underground Pass and confronted him at the city gates.

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: I tried to reason with him, but he had already decided that I was his enemy. We had the numbers and our forces were better skilled, so we tried to besiege the city.

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: The Iorwerth forces had the strength and safety of the city walls though. They slowly whittled us down until we were too weak to carry on. We had no choice but to retreat.

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: We fell back into the Underground Pass, intending to return to our kingdom in the east. Lord Iorwerth sent his forces in after us, hoping to wipe us out.

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: We no longer had the strength in numbers, but we still outmatched the Iorwerth troops in skill and experience. We fought back while we retreated. Both sides suffered huge losses.

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: Eventually we managed to make it through to the other side. By then, there were few of us left. Lord Iorwerth had failed to wipe us out, but he knew we were beaten.

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: While we were gone, an uprising had occurred in the eastern kingdom. We took our best fighters to Prifddinas, those that remained were unable to hold back the enemy.

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: My wife was taken and most of my people were slaughtered. I turned my attention to finding my wife and getting the rest of my people to safety.

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: Lord Iorwerth became the least of my problems. I suspect he didn't consider me much of a threat at that point anyway.

steps.player: What was Seren like?

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: She... She was wonderful. She taught us to better ourselves in every way possible. Everything we know, everything we are, it all came from her.

steps.player: I wish I could have met her.

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: I feel very blessed to have been able to. The love she had for us, it's unlike anything I've ever seen.

steps.player: Sounds like she was pretty much perfect.

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: Well... not quite. Many of the elves alive now were not around when Seren was still with us. They only know her through the stories passed down to them. The stories don't tell everything though.

steps.player: What do you mean?

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: Seren was remarkable, but under the surface, she hid a great pain. A sadness unlike any other. She never spoke of it, but when you looked hard enough, you could see the anguish.

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: I guess we all have our demons, even the gods. Seren was a beacon of light in this grim world, but the brightest light casts the darkest shadow, and none shone brighter than her.

options.text: What do you think of the current elves?

steps.player: What do you think of the current elves?

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: Arianwyn and the rebels have done well to keep going for this long. They've been fighting this war for centuries, and yet they've never given up. I have much respect for them, they're far stronger than I ever was.

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: Most of them are still young though. They lack the wisdom of the older elves, the ones who were around when Seren still walked this earth. Many of them never saw Prifddinas before the song of inversion.

steps.player: Is that a bad thing?

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: Not necessarily, but it is something to be cautious of. That which they fight for, it's a mere dream to them. They should remember that dreams seldom come true.

steps.player: I'll be back later.
I'd better be off.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: Welcome back [player name]. While you were gone, I filled Baxtorian in on everything that has happened. I also took the liberty of calling the others here, so that we can discuss our next move.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Eluned
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: You also missed out on Islwyn getting to meet his grandfather for the first time. I think he might have cried a little.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Islwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: Cried? In your dreams Eluned.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: I appreciate we're all happy to have Baxtorian back with us, but let's not get distracted.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Eluned
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: Apologies, Arianwyn.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: Right, over to you Baxtorian.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: Thank you, Arianwyn. I... Forgive me, it's been a long time since I last chaired a meeting like this. Much has changed since then as well.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: Take your time.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: Thank you friend.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: Arianwyn has informed me of Lord Iorwerth's revelation...

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Ysgawyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: Do you believe his claims?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: About Seren? No. As for him breaking a seal in the Grand Library... I... do not know.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Ysgawyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: You don't know? What do you mean you don't know?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: Ysgawyn...

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: I know not what the seals hide. What I do know is that they could, in theory, be broken.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: I was lucky enough to be trusted by Seren. She confided in me many times. She never told me what knowledge the seals guard, but she did tell me that they could be destroyed.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: I don't know exactly. She said that those who follow the light would be able to access her knowledge.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Ysgawyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: And that's it? This gives us nothing to go on.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Islwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: Not nothing. We now know that the seals can be destroyed, which means Lord Iorwerth could have spoken the truth.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Ysgawyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: But without access to the Grand Library, we have no way to be sure.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: Well... we might still have a way.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Eluned
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: A way to access the library?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: Yes... Prifddinas may have been reverted to seed, but it does still exist.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Ysgawyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: You're not suggesting we restore the city are you? Even if we could, Lord Iorwerth would instantly take it.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: No. While Lord Iorwerth is at large, Prifddinas must remain as it is. However, there may be a way to still enter the city.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: You don't mean entering the crystal do you?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Ysgawyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: That's not possible.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Ilfeen
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: Actually, I think it would be possible. The crystal seed that contains Prifddinas, it's not the same as the seeds we use to form weapons and armour.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Ilfeen
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: The seed contains Prifddinas, but the seed itself is not the city.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Elena
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: So it's like a box?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Ilfeen
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: Exactly, and if we can enter the box...

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Islwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: We can enter Prifddinas!

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: That's the idea. It won't be straightforward though.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: We will need a special potion to be able to safely enter the crystal seed. We'll also need to be able to bypass the defences around it as well.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Elena
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: A potion? Sounds like my area of expertise.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: Perfect. Elena, if you could help create this potion, that would be greatly appreciated. The rest of us can work on those defences.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Elena
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: Right. [player name], meet me by the pond. I could use your help with this.
The others leave the meeting.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: Oh... Hello there.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.player: What do I need to do now?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: I've given Elena the information she needs to make that potion. You should speak to her by the pond.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.player: What do I need to do now?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-the-second.text: Baxtorian has given Elena the information she needs to make this potion. You should speak to her by the pond.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: If you chose "Maybe later." when she wanted to ask you something before the first meeting:

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Hi.

steps.player: Hey Elena.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: If you chose "Go ahead." and picked the full options when she wanted to ask you something before the first meeting:

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Hey [player name]. Glad everything went okay at Baxtorian Falls.

steps.player: Thanks. Anything exciting happen while I was gone?

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Nope, all nice and quiet for a change.

steps.player: Good to hear.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Elena
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: Baxtorian is an interesting one, isn't he?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Elena
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: Lost?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Elena
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: He reminds me of a story my father once told me. A story of a broken man.

steps.player: What was the story?

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: A long time ago, there were two brothers living in Avarrocka. They lived a simple life, farming the land and selling the produce to people in the city.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: When war came to the city, the king ordered that every able-bodied man take up arms against the enemy. The two brothers had to leave their home behind, to fight for a king they'd never met.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Like everyone else, they were given basic weapons and basic training. Enough to give them a chance, but not a big one. When the fighting started, they were poorly equipped and poorly prepared.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: They fought in many battles. Battles in strange places against strange people. As the war dragged on, they saw more and more horrors, from both sides. The only thing that kept them going was each other.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: As the war drew to a close, they were called to one final battle. The enemy knew they were losing, and they fought more ferociously than ever before.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: That was where it happened. One of the brothers was cut off and surrounded. He tried to fight back, but he didn't stand a chance.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Eventually the fighting stopped, and the war was over. The other brother could finally go home. But the truth is, he had nothing to go home to.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: It wasn't the farm that mattered, not really. The thing that mattered to him was gone.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: In a way, he'd died back on the battlefield alongside his brother. Left in his place was just a broken man, with nothing left to live for.

steps.player: Hmm. And you think Baxtorian is like this broken man?

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: He lost his wife, his people and his kingdom. Now he's in a strange place, surrounded by strange people, helping to fight a war that he lost a long time ago.

options.text: Now's not the time for stories, Elena.

steps.player: Now's not the time for stories, Elena.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: I guess you're right. The short of it is, Baxtorian has lost everything that he cared about. He's just an empty shell now, with nothing left to live for.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.player: Maybe he's not totally lost. He still has Islwyn, and we can still turn this war around.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Elena
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: Maybe. I guess only time will tell.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Elena
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: Right. Shall we get started with this potion?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Elena
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: Baxtorian gave me the details. To start with, we need an elder cadantine herb. We should be able to grow one from a normal cadantine seed, we just need to prepare the patch a little differently.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Elena
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: The elves have said we can use this farming patch here. While I prepare the patch, could you go and fetch a cadantine seed and a seed dibber?
If the player already has a Cadantine seed:

steps.player: I already have the seed here.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Well it also happens that I've actually already prepared the patch, so you can get started right away.

steps.player: How convenient.

steps.speaker: Elena
steps.text: Indeed. When you're ready, go ahead and plant the seed.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: If the player doesn't have a Cadantine seed:

steps.player: Will do, I'll be back soon.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Elena
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: Hey [player name]. Do you have that seed yet?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Elena
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: It's a cadantine seed that we need. Let me know once you have one. You'll want to get a seed dibber as well so we can plant it.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Elena
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: Hey [player name]. Do you have that seed yet?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Elena
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: Great. The patch is all prepared so just plant it when you're ready.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Elena
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: Great. I'll keep an eye on the patch while it grows. You should check in with Arianwyn and Baxtorian in the meantime.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: Hello [player name], how's the potion going?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.player: We've planted the herb we need, now we have to wait for it to grow. Is there something I can do in the meantime?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: I suspect there is. Myself and Baxtorian have been looking over how we can get past the defences around the crystal seed.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: The crystal seed containing Prifddinas, it lies in the middle of the clearing where the city once stood. The only thing left of the city itself are the walls.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: These are no ordinary walls though. Long ago, they were reinforced by various enchantments to protect Prifddinas during the God Wars.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: With Prifddinas gone, Lord Iorwerth has claimed the land where it once was. He's managed to manipulate the defences to only allow his allies to enter.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.player: So how do we get past them?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: While the Iorwerth clan may hold some magical knowledge... they are not mystics. I have no doubt that their work was crude at best, work that a true master of the magical arts could overcome.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.player: I see. And where do we find a true master of the magical arts?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: There were eight separate elven clans that journeyed with Seren to this world. Those eight clans still exist today, with each elf born into one of them.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: You'll have already heard of some of the clans. The Iorwerth clan is known to you, the traitorous clan of assassins and slayers.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: And the Cadarn clan of course, the warrior clan of which myself and Arianwyn are part of.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: The other clans you might be less familiar with. However, one of those clans is key here, the Amlodd clan, the clan of mystics.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: It was the Amlodd clan who created the Prifddinas defences. Their clan should have the knowledge needed to overcome them. And of all the Amlodd clan, none know more than Lord Ieuan Amlodd himself.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.player: And where do we find him?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: After Prifddinas was reverted to seed, the clan elders went into hiding. Before we parted ways, the others did leave me with some clues on how to find them.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: Lord Amlodd may be our priority, but the other elders could be of great help in our fight against Lord Iorwerth. We should try and find them all.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: I've managed to decipher the clue left behind by Lord Amlodd. We should be able to use it to find him. I've also started work on the other clues.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: Apart from Lord Amlodd, I've only been able to decipher Lady Trahaearn's clue so far. I'll keep working on the others though.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: [player name], myself and Baxtorian will continue to work on deciphering these clues. While we do, it would be of great help if you could find Lord Amlodd and Lady Trahaearn for us.

options.text: How do I find Lord Amlodd?

steps.player: How do I find Lord Amlodd?

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: Here is the clue he left behind: 'The elven crystal will lead you to me.'

steps.player: I see, anything else I should know?

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: The Amlodd clan is a clan of mystics. Some sort of magic may be key to finding Lord Amlodd. You might also find this of use, Lord Amlodd gave it to me before we went our seperate ways.
If the player has no inventory space:
Baxtorian tries to give you a crystal seed but you don't have enough room to take it.
If the player has inventory space:
Baxtorian gives you a crystal seed.

options.text: How do I find Lady Trahaearn?

steps.player: How do I find Lady Trahaearn?

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: Here is the clue she left behind: 'I will journey south from the well.'

steps.player: I see, anything else I should know?

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: The Trahaearn clan is a clan of smiths and miners. It's possible that you'll need to use your smithing and mining skills to find Lady Trahaearn.

steps.player: Okay, I'll get started.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.player: What do I need to do now?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: We need you to find Lord Amlodd and Lady Trahaearn for us. Speak to Baxtorian, he can tell you about the clues they left behind.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-talking-to.text: Oh... Hello there.

options.text: How do I find Lord Amlodd?
How do I find Lady Trahaearn?
I'd like to ask you something about yourself.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-lo.text: It's a small crystal seed. It looks to be inactive. It will need enchanting before it can do anything.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-lo.speaker: Eluned
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-lo.text: Hello again, how is it going?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-lo.speaker: Eluned
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-lo.text: It's good to have you helping us. We're all very grateful.

options.text: I have a seed from Baxtorian that I think needs enchanting.

steps.player: I have a seed from Baxtorian that I think needs enchanting.

steps.speaker: Eluned
steps.text: Okay, let me see what I can do with it.
Eluned hands you an enchanted crystal seed.

steps.speaker: Eluned
steps.text: There you go. Be careful with it, I'm not sure what it will do when used.

steps.player: Thanks for the warning, see you later.

options.text: It's the least I can do. I'll see you later.

steps.player: It's the least I can do. I'll see you later.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.text: The player rubs the seed, arriving at the Enchanted Valley next to a Mysterious Figure.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.speaker: Mysterious Figure
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.text: Look at this place... It's beautiful, is it not?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.speaker: Mysterious Figure
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.text: Amlodd? A curious name... Why do you ask?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.player: Baxtorian sent me. He gave me a crystal that belonged to Lord Amlodd. It brought me here, to you.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.speaker: Mysterious Figure
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.text: I have a question for you. This valley before us, how would you describe it?

steps.player: Beautiful.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Figure
steps.text: Yes... It's nice to look upon such beauty, it reminds me of my home. The crystal spires of Prifddinas.

steps.player: Dangerous.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Figure
steps.text: Yes... This world... it's so peaceful, so beautiful. But there is still danger here. It takes me back to the forests near my home, before Lord Iorwerth brought a different danger upon us.

steps.player: Peaceful.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Figure
steps.text: Yes... It is a welcome break from the wars of my home, the wars of Lord Iorwerth.

steps.player: Boring.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Figure
steps.text: I suppose it can seem that way. Little to see and little to do. But there is beauty in that simplicity, much like the forest of Isafdar.

steps.player: I don't know.

steps.speaker: Mysterious Figure
steps.text: The answers are not always easy to find. I have had time to reflect here, to consider this world. Maybe you need more time to find your own answer. Alas, it is time we do not have, for Lord Iorwerth awaits.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.text: Indeed, and if Baxtorian sent you, then it is time for me to leave this place. Tell me human, where must I travel to?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.player: The village of Lletya, in the forest of Isafdar.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.text: Then we shall leave at once. Allow me to teleport you back with me.
Lord Amlodd teleports you both back to Lletya.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.text: The rebels have created a wonderful village here. A safe refuge from the tyranny of Lord Iorwerth. Curious how something so beautiful could be born of something so terrible.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.player: They've done well to keep up the fight for this long.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.text: They have, but I'd expect no less of them. The song of the elves has been sung for thousands of years, it will continue for thousands more.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-a-mysterio.text: However, I fear that this verse is the darkest yet.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.text: She seems to be in a deep sleep. She's wearing a strange exoskeleton made from runite. The exoskeleton is damaged and needs repairing.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.speaker: Lady Tangwen Trahaearn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.text: Who has awoken me? A human? You are not who I expected.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.player: Baxtorian sent me. We need your help in the fight against Lord Iorwerth.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.speaker: Lady Tangwen Trahaearn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.text: Baxtorian lives? And he is working with a human? This is most irregular. I see you repaired my exoskeleton as well. Impressive work for a human, but again, most irregular.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.speaker: Lady Tangwen Trahaearn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.text: Tell me human, where is Baxtorian?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.player: He's in the elven village of Lletya, south of here.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.speaker: Lady Tangwen Trahaearn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.text: Then I will journey there at once. There is clearly a lot I need to catch up on.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.speaker: Lady Tangwen Trahaearn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.text: These rebels had better get a move on and defeat Lord Iorwerth. Old ladies like me have a tendency to drop dead, and I'll be very annoyed if that happens before I see Prifddinas again.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.player: How can you be annoyed if you're dead?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.speaker: Lady Tangwen Trahaearn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.text: Oh I'll cook up quite the storm in the afterlife, believe me.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.text: Good job finding Lord Amlodd and Lady Trahaearn. Now, you should probably go see how that seed you planted is doing.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.player: Good idea, I'll go see Elena.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.text: Oh... Hello there. Thank you for finding Lord Amlodd and Lady Trahaearn.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-finding-la.text: Have you checked in with Elena recently? That seed has probably grown by now.

options.text: I'd like to ask you something about yourself.

steps.player: I'll go talk to her.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Elena
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Hey [player name]. The elder cadantine herb grew perfectly. Let's get it harvested.
Elena harvests the elder cadantine.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.player: So what else do we need for the potion?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Elena
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: The other ingredient is crystal dust. Hopefully you can get some from Arianwyn or Baxtorian. Once you've got some dust, just add it to a vial of water along with the herb.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.player: Right, I'll go see if I can get some crystal dust.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Elena
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Don't forget this.
If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: Elena tries to give you some elder cadantine but you don't have enough room for it.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: If the player has inventory space:

steps.text: Elena gives you some elder cadantine.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.player: Hey Elena, what do I need to do again?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Elena
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Add the elder cadantine to a vial of water and then add some crystal dust. Hopefully either Arianwyn or Baxtorian can give you some crystal dust.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Oh... Hello. Do you need something?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.player: I need some crystal dust for this potion I'm making.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Ah yes... I don't have anything you can use I'm afraid. Maybe Arianwyn can help you.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Hello [player name]. How's it going?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.player: I'm working on getting that potion made. I need some crystal dust for it though.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Crystal dust? Interesting. Well I have an old crystal here that you can use. It will need grinding up though.
If the player has no inventory space:

steps.text: Arianwyn tries to give you an old crystal but you don't have enough room to take it.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: If the player has inventory space:

steps.text: Arianwyn gives you an old crystal.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Hello [player name]. How's it going?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.player: I'm working on getting that potion made. I need some crystal dust for it though.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Why don't you try using that crystal I gave you?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Elena
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Hey [player name].

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.player: Hey Elena, I've finished the potion.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Elena
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Great, you should take it to Arianwyn and Baxtorian.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Oh... Hello. Do you need something?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Oh... You should give it to Arianwyn then.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.player: I should probably take this to Arianwyn and Baxtorian rather than drinking it.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Hello [player name]. How's it going?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Great, I'll look after it for you. Now, let's call the others and discuss our plan for the Grand Library.
Arianwyn calls the others to the meeting.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Right, thanks to [player name], we should now have everything we need to enter the crystal seed containing Prifddinas.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Eluned
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: So we have a way to bypass the defences?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Arianwyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Indeed we do. Baxtorian's knowledge allowed [player name] to reunite us with Lord Amlodd and Lady Trahaearn. It was the Amlodd clan that created those defences, Lord Amlodd can overcome them for us.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: My magic can be used to teleport someone through the defences and into the crystal. It will require great focus though, I will only be able to send one of you in.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Baxtorian
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: The inversion potion will ensure that whoever is sent survives the journey, now we just need to decide who that is.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Islwyn

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Ysgawyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: You cannot be serious? Even if [player name] has proven their worth as you claim, which I have my doubts about, they'll never be deemed worthy enough to unlock Seren's hidden knowledge.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Ilfeen
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Why? Because they're not an elf?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Ysgawyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Exactly! If Seren created a way for the seals to be destroyed, she would have made it so that only an elf could break them.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Ysgawyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: I... Well of course not.

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Lady Tangwen Trahaearn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: Then how do you know what our goddess intended?

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Ysgawyn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: I just think...

preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.speaker: Lady Tangwen Trahaearn
preparing-to-enter-prifddinas-making-the.text: I don't know this human here, but I damn well don't know you either. The human was capable enough to find me and fix my exoskeleton. Maybe they are capable of this as well.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.text: The Grand Library of Prifddinas, such a beautiful place. You will be the first to step foot there for hundreds of years.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.player: What do I need to do once I arrive?

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.text: They say Lord Iorwerth broke one of the nine seals of Seren within the library. Find this seal, and see what knowledge he uncovered.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.text: Once that is done, seek out the other eight seals, see if you can break them as well. Their knowledge may be key to our fight against the darkness.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.player: Do you have any idea how to break the seals?

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.text: According to Baxtorian, Seren herself said that those who follow the light will be able to access her knowledge.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.player: That doesn't give me a lot to go on.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.text: No, but it is all you have. Now, when you are ready, I can teleport you into the crystal seed. I have the potion that you made earlier, it will ensure you survive the journey.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.text: One last thing, the laws that this land abide by, they may not apply in the library.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.speaker: Lord Ieuan Amlodd
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-entering.text: The library has been reverted to crystal. That which is impossible out here, may well be normal in an environment like that. You should be cautious.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.player: I seek that knowledge, to help in the fight against Lord Iorwerth.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: It is not my place to question why. I only exist to pass on that which she sealed away.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.player: So you'll give me the knowledge?

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: The seals guard the truth. This seal has been broken, its knowledge is now open to all. Here is what you seek:

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: '...Therein lies my guilt. A part of me, trapped and alone. Dark, yes, but still a part of my being, sealed away in the Temple of Light.'

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: 'The protections on the temple, they should keep her contained. But in case they don't, I created one last safeguard, a prison within a prison. With it I made a key, an orb of light, to unlock the darkness.'

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: 'I could have destroyed it, sealed her away forever. But I still question my decision, and so I hid the orb away, while I think upon my choices.'

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: 'The shrine at Gorlah, that is where it lies. With it, she can be freed... or destroyed...'

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: And so ends the knowledge of this seal.

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.player: So Lord Iorwerth spoke the truth. A part of Seren lives within the Temple of Light. But why?

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: 'When I first encountered the elves on their homeworld of Tarddiad, it was like I had finally found my purpose. I quickly fell in love with them, and they with me.'

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: 'I set out to help them, to guide them. They immediately embraced this, and one of their mystics, Ceidwad, documented my teachings in a great book called the Cerddi.'

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.text: 'It was the start of something beautiful, but there is pain in beauty, as I soon came to realise...'

the-grand-library-of-prifddinas-the-seal.speaker: Memory of Seren
