options.text: Baxtorian said you had an idea to help our defence.

steps.player: I'd better go.

options.text: Baxtorian said you had an idea to help our defence.

preparations-at-the-dwarf-camp-placing-e.text: You place the potion in the hole and gently cover the top with dirt.

preparations-at-the-dwarf-camp-placing-e.player: That's the last of them. I'd better get back to Baxtorian.

preparations-at-the-dwarf-camp-talking-t.speaker: Elena
preparations-at-the-dwarf-camp-talking-t.text: [player name], Lord Iorwerth's forces are approaching, you'd better go see Baxtorian.

preparations-at-the-dwarf-camp-talking-t.player: Will do, thanks Elena.

preparations-at-the-dwarf-camp-talking-t.speaker: Elena
preparations-at-the-dwarf-camp-talking-t.text: And [player name]...

preparations-at-the-dwarf-camp-talking-t.player: Elena?

preparations-at-the-dwarf-camp-talking-t.speaker: Elena
preparations-at-the-dwarf-camp-talking-t.text: Come back alive.

preparations-at-the-dwarf-camp-a-final-m.speaker: Baxtorian
preparations-at-the-dwarf-camp-a-final-m.text: Good, because we're out of time. A message came into the camp, Lord Iorwerth wishes to meet.

preparations-at-the-dwarf-camp-a-final-m.player: He wants to meet? Surely it's a trap?

preparations-at-the-dwarf-camp-a-final-m.speaker: Baxtorian
preparations-at-the-dwarf-camp-a-final-m.text: Maybe, but I don't think so. Even if nothing came of it, he was willing to meet me before the Siege of Prifddinas all those years ago.

preparations-at-the-dwarf-camp-a-final-m.player: So what are you going to do?

preparations-at-the-dwarf-camp-a-final-m.speaker: Baxtorian
preparations-at-the-dwarf-camp-a-final-m.text: I will go. If there's a chance to avoid bloodshed, we should take it, no matter how slim the odds are. I would like you to join me.

preparations-at-the-dwarf-camp-a-final-m.player: You think Lord Iorwerth will listen to me?

preparations-at-the-dwarf-camp-a-final-m.speaker: Baxtorian
preparations-at-the-dwarf-camp-a-final-m.text: No, but maybe Arianwyn will. He considered you a friend, he may still care for what you have to say.

preparations-at-the-dwarf-camp-a-final-m.player: I see. Then I will join you.

preparations-at-the-dwarf-camp-a-final-m.speaker: Baxtorian
preparations-at-the-dwarf-camp-a-final-m.text: Thank you friend. Now, Lord Iorwerth is unlikely to be patient, but we can spare a bit of time. If there's anyone you wish to talk to here, I suggest you do so before we depart. You may not get another chance.

preparations-at-the-dwarf-camp-a-final-m.speaker: Baxtorian
preparations-at-the-dwarf-camp-a-final-m.text: Let me know when you're ready to go.

steps.player: I'm ready.

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: Then we will leave at once.

options.text: I'd like to ask you something about yourself.

steps.player: I'll be back soon.

steps.speaker: Baxtorian
steps.text: Don't take too long. I'll be here when you're ready.

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Baxtorian
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: Lord Iorwerth.

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: King Baxtorian.

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Baxtorian
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: I'm not a king... not anymore.

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: No. You never really were a king though were you? A king doesn't abandon his people like you did.

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Baxtorian
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: I did not come here to trade insults.

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: Really? So why did you come then?

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.player: We came to put an end to this. To put aside our differences and stop this war before more people die needlessly.

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: You talk sense human, and yet you stand beside the warmonger himself.

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.player: You have a fair share of blood on your hands as well you know.

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: I do. I have done many unspeakable things, things that haunt me every day. But what I did, I did for the good of my people.

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: Whereas he, he only ever cared for himself.

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: Go on, deny it. Just like you always do.

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Baxtorian
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: I don't deny it. I failed my people, I failed you. I was never a worthy king, I know that now. But you can't use my failures as a mask to hide your own.

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: We can stand here going around in circles all day, you won't change my mind.

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.player: If you're not willing to change your mind, why even bother to meet us?

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: In the hope that I might still change yours. I don't want anyone else to die in this war. I give you the chance to stand down.

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Baxtorian
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: And what happens if we do?

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: We enter the temple, free our goddess and with her by our side, reform the city of Prifddinas.

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Baxtorian
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: And we all live happily ever after?

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: In a manner of speaking.

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.player: That temple, it doesn't contain your goddess. At best, it contains a shadow of what she once was.

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: Yes, Arianwyn told me what you discovered in the library. It matters not though, that is a part of our goddess in there, we have to free her.

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Baxtorian
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: And if she's evil? What do you do then?

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: My loyalty is to Seren, I will let her decide what is evil.

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Arianwyn
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: That... that's not what we agreed.

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: What?

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Arianwyn
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: We agreed to enter the temple and free Seren. If that's not Seren in there, we shouldn't free her.

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: I will keep my promise to you Arianwyn, you should not doubt that.

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.player: Why shouldn't he doubt that? You burnt his home, you killed his friends. You haven't given him much reason to trust you so far.

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: I did what I needed to do to save our goddess. No one would have needed to die had you not forced our hand.

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.player: Listen to him Arianwyn, he'd sacrifice everything and everyone just to free whatever is in that temple. Is that really what you want?

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: Enough of this! You can try to manipulate him all you want, he's made his choice.

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: Now, I'm afraid I'll need to push you on a decision.

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Baxtorian
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: I'm sorry, but we can't let you enter that temple.

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: A shame. As unlikely as it was, I did hope you might see reason.

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: I think we're done here then. For what it's worth, I'm sorry it had to end this way.

sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.speaker: Baxtorian
sealing-the-underground-pass-meeting-wit.text: As am I.

sealing-the-underground-pass-attack-of-t.text: The blockage is blown up, and Essylt arrives with two Iorwerth Warriors. Essylt immediately attacks Elena.

sealing-the-underground-pass-attack-of-t.speaker: Essyllt
sealing-the-underground-pass-attack-of-t.text: Ha! Looks like you were too slow my friend.

sealing-the-underground-pass-attack-of-t.speaker: Essyllt
sealing-the-underground-pass-attack-of-t.text: Or what? Will you murder me in cold blood like you did with King Tyras?

sealing-the-underground-pass-attack-of-t.speaker: Essyllt
sealing-the-underground-pass-attack-of-t.text: You can lie to yourself all you want, I know what you are. You enjoy killing, just like I do.

sealing-the-underground-pass-attack-of-t.speaker: Essyllt
sealing-the-underground-pass-attack-of-t.text: The satisfaction when I finally put an end to that fool Ysgawyn, it was beautiful. It was even better than when I dealt with that stupid lover of his.

sealing-the-underground-pass-attack-of-t.speaker: Essyllt
sealing-the-underground-pass-attack-of-t.text: But if that wasn't enough, now I get to be the one to finally put an end to you and your pathetic girlfriend!

sealing-the-underground-pass-attack-of-t.speaker: Essyllt
sealing-the-underground-pass-attack-of-t.text: Oh I'm going to enjoy this...
Lord Iorwerth and Arianwyn arrive, with two Iorwerth Warriors and Archers behind them.
Lord Iorwerth and Arianwyn proceed to enter the Temple of Light, with Baxtorian chasing after them.

sealing-the-underground-pass-attack-of-t.speaker: Eluned
sealing-the-underground-pass-attack-of-t.text: Don't worry, I'll take care of her.

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-freed.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-freed.text: This is it, this is what we've spent the last thousand years fighting for. Today, it will finally all be worth it.

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-freed.speaker: Baxtorian
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-freed.text: Lord Iorwerth please, see reason. That thing is not Seren, it's not our goddess.

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-freed.speaker: Baxtorian
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-freed.text: I knew Seren, I'm the only one here that did, and I know that isn't her.

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-freed.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-freed.text: Time can change a lot of things, perhaps Seren has changed as well.

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-freed.speaker: Arianwyn
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-freed.text: I... I don't think it's her.

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-freed.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-freed.text: Of course it's her! Don't tell me you believe Baxtorian and his lies?

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-freed.speaker: Arianwyn
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-freed.text: I may not have met our goddess, but I heard enough stories to know what she looked like. This thing, it's not her.

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-freed.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-freed.text: Well lucky for us, we have a way of finding out.

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-freed.speaker: Arianwyn
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-freed.text: Lord Iorwerth please, this isn't what we agreed.

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-freed.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-freed.text: I know what we agreed Arianwyn! We agreed to free our goddess, and that's what I'm going to do!
Arianwyn shoots Lord Iorwerth, critically injuring him, and the player is dragged into the Fragment of Seren's realm.

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-enrag.speaker: Fragment of Seren
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-enrag.text: You... you've come to free me?

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-enrag.player: What's going on? Why's everything so dark?

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-enrag.speaker: Fragment of Seren
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-enrag.text: Dark? All I've ever known is darkness. It's all she gave me.

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-enrag.speaker: Fragment of Seren
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-enrag.text: You haven't come to free me at all have you? You're one of her servants!

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-enrag.speaker: Fragment of Seren
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-enrag.text: I loved her! She made me! But I couldn't be what she wanted, so she abandoned me! And now she can't bear to kill me herself, so she sends you instead!

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-enrag.speaker: Fragment of Seren
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-enrag.text: I won't let you! It's not fair! She doesn't get to do this! I don't want it!

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-enrag.speaker: Fragment of Seren
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-enrag.text: No! Get out! Get out! Get out!

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.speaker: Fragment of Seren
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.text: She acted like I was a monster! Come... look upon her monster!

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.speaker: Fragment of Seren
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.text: She left me, like I wasn't real! But I know what's real, do you?

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.speaker: Fragment of Seren
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.text: Did she think I would rot here? I am eternal, unlike you!

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.speaker: Fragment of Seren
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.text: She feared my power, and she was right to! Let me show you...

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.speaker: Fragment of Seren
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.text: Look at me! Look at what she made me! Do you see?

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.speaker: Fragment of Seren
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.text: She treated me like I was less than her, but I'm so much more!

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.speaker: Fragment of Seren
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.text: I won't let her destroy me! She doesn't get to decide that!

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.speaker: Fragment of Seren
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.text: This power, she gave it to me! It's her power too! Feel it!

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.speaker: Fragment of Seren
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.text: I just wanted her to love me, but she wouldn't even look at me!

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.speaker: Fragment of Seren
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.text: She tried to forget me, but everywhere she looked she saw me!

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.speaker: Fragment of Seren
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.text: I have more power than she ever did! I will survive!

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.speaker: Fragment of Seren
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.text: Do you know pain? I do! She made sure of that! I'll show you...

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.speaker: Fragment of Seren
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.text: Come! Come look upon her work, and despair!

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.speaker: Fragment of Seren
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.text: Do you think she cares? Maybe reality isn't what you think...

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.speaker: Fragment of Seren
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.text: I am infinite! As hard as she tries, I can't be destroyed!

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.speaker: Fragment of Seren
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.text: The pain she caused me, let me give you a taste of it!

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.speaker: Fragment of Seren
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.text: Are you afraid? Too scared to even look at me?

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.speaker: Fragment of Seren
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.text: I'm better than her! I'm greater than her! That's what she hated!

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.speaker: Fragment of Seren
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.text: The things I've endured, do you think you could endure them?

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.speaker: Fragment of Seren
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-battl.text: She didn't love me! She feared the strength of her own creation!

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-defea.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-defea.text: She was confused, she was hurt. Yes, she was angry, but she was innocent!

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-defea.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-defea.text: How? With violence? That's all you know isn't it?

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-defea.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-defea.text: She just needed time, time to understand, time to overcome her pain. She was our goddess, the last hope for our people. And now, she's gone, because of you.

the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-defea.speaker: Lord Iorwerth
the-fragment-of-seren-the-fragment-defea.text: I hope you can live with yourself...
Lord Iorwerth succumbs to his wounds, and dies.

the-war-s-end-arianwyn-atones.speaker: Arianwyn
the-war-s-end-arianwyn-atones.text: As well as can be expected. My guilt is a heavy load. A lot of people died because of me.

the-war-s-end-arianwyn-atones.player: A lot more might have died if you hadn't stopped Lord Iorwerth.

the-war-s-end-arianwyn-atones.speaker: Arianwyn
the-war-s-end-arianwyn-atones.text: He wasn't evil, not truly. He just became so obsessed with his goal that he forgot why he started fighting in the first place.

the-war-s-end-arianwyn-atones.speaker: Arianwyn
the-war-s-end-arianwyn-atones.text: As for the fragment of Seren... I wish there had been another way.

the-war-s-end-arianwyn-atones.player: She wasn't Seren, and she never would have been.

the-war-s-end-arianwyn-atones.speaker: Arianwyn
the-war-s-end-arianwyn-atones.text: No, and at least now her pain has ended. Still, I'll always wonder what could have been...

the-war-s-end-arianwyn-atones.speaker: Arianwyn
the-war-s-end-arianwyn-atones.text: There's no place for me here anymore, not after what I've done.

the-war-s-end-arianwyn-atones.speaker: Arianwyn
the-war-s-end-arianwyn-atones.text: I wanted to stay long enough to help repair the damage of my actions, and to look upon Prifddinas for the first time. I've done that now. Lletya has been rebuilt and Prifddinas has been reformed.

the-war-s-end-arianwyn-atones.speaker: Arianwyn
the-war-s-end-arianwyn-atones.text: I don't know. There's a lot of places on this world that I've never seen. Maybe one of them will help me find redemption, and forgiveness.

the-war-s-end-arianwyn-atones.speaker: Arianwyn
the-war-s-end-arianwyn-atones.text: The elves here will do fine. Baxtorian has his own path of redemption to go on, and I imagine he'll struggle far more than me. He has the other elders to support him though. Under them, our people will prosper.

the-war-s-end-arianwyn-atones.speaker: Arianwyn
the-war-s-end-arianwyn-atones.text: Anyway, you should get going. Baxtorian will be waiting for you.

the-war-s-end-prifddinas-reformed.player: Hey, good to see you both.
I thought the city had been restored, I don't see anything though.

the-war-s-end-prifddinas-reformed.speaker: Baxtorian
the-war-s-end-prifddinas-reformed.text: One of the security measures put in place during the God Wars, from the outside it seems like there's nothing there. Don't worry though, the restoration is complete.

the-war-s-end-prifddinas-reformed.speaker: Baxtorian
the-war-s-end-prifddinas-reformed.text: Speaking of which, myself and the other elders have come to an agreement. For too long, we've been afraid of outsiders, showing them mistrust while our own kind plot against us.

the-war-s-end-prifddinas-reformed.speaker: Baxtorian
the-war-s-end-prifddinas-reformed.text: After all that's happened, we've decided that from now on, that will no longer be the case. We will open our city up to the other races, letting them walk among us for the first time.

the-war-s-end-prifddinas-reformed.speaker: Baxtorian
the-war-s-end-prifddinas-reformed.text: As a thank you for all that you've done, we'd like the two of you to be the first to enter Prifddinas.

the-war-s-end-prifddinas-reformed.speaker: Elena
the-war-s-end-prifddinas-reformed.text: They've also agreed to let me move into the city. That tiny house in Ardougne was becoming a bit tiresome, and there's so much for me to learn from the Meilyr elves.

the-war-s-end-prifddinas-reformed.player: Well I'll be sure to come and visit.
Now that the city has been reformed, are you going to become king of the elves again?

the-war-s-end-prifddinas-reformed.speaker: Baxtorian
the-war-s-end-prifddinas-reformed.text: Oh I said my days as a king were done, and I meant it. From now on, the elves will be jointly ruled by the eight clan elders. No single elf will ever rule again. We've realised that we're not overly good at it.

the-war-s-end-prifddinas-reformed.speaker: Baxtorian
the-war-s-end-prifddinas-reformed.text: But anyway, we can talk more later. For now, I'd say it's time for the two of you to see Prifddinas.

zWmqLP.speaker: Councillor Halgrive
zWmqLP.text: Very well, return to us once you are ready.
